ba la bka' stsal pa/ kun tu dpa' ba khyod phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su song ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la deng de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por chos ston gyisamanya)phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa khyedatshan/thams cad thal mo sbyar te thud gecig ces de skad smos la go bar byas ma thag tu yud tsam gyis chos nyan du slar shog shig④ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal55)nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor 47ba byas te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rtso)stobs kyis mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su song nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la deng de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por chos ston gyisani/ de la khyod cagashegis legs so zhes bya ba gsol cig dang / de'i phyir khyed deng nyid du phan pa dang bde ba chen po thob par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi77khams rnams su song nas sangs rgyas thams cad la bsnyen bkur byas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sgron〈nyepa ni 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas se gol gtogs7)pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'ongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyipha7spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de na0bram ze rnams dang / gzhan mu stegs〈nyecan spyod7pa pa77dang ske/ kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa rnams kyang 'dus/ lha dang / klu 48wa 636

dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / mi mang po zhig dang / rgyal po g.yog dang bcas pa lnga brgya tsam yang 'dus/ bdud sdig can g.yog dang bcas pa bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa gsum yang 'dus so/ /yang de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po rab tu g.yos so/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi0)khams rnams su lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma'i char rab tu bab(lta/ lha'i me tog gi55)char kyang54kyirab tu bab nas de bcom ldan 'das kyi (5)dbu'i spyi gtsug gi mtshams55)su khang pa brtsegs par kun tu gnas so/ /yang de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rdo rje gsor ba dang / de nas de'i tshe phyogs bzhi nas rlung gi rgyal po bzhi 'khrugs te/ langs nas gang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i nyal nyil dang / phyag dar dang / bye ma de rnams grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu bor nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su spos chu'i char rab tu phabadu/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyilo)khams rnams su me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu tam dang / pad ma dkar po'i char kyang〈nyarab tu phab nas me tog de dag thams cad kyang sems can de dag gi spyi gtsug gi steng du me tog gi gdugs su gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug gi steng gi〈nyebar snang la nyi khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong kun tu gnas te/ khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong po rnams kyis benang nas rin po che sna bdun gyi khri brgyad khri bzhi stong byung ste/ khri de dag thams cad la yang skode bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs nas chos ston to/ /de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba bcom ldan 'das 48wa 637

ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po 'dir cho 'phrul 'di lta bu gda' ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta ste dper na mi tsa ya can rgod detub bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / bdag gir 'dzin pa la gnas pa dbul por gyur pa la la zhig yod la de'i mgo la rgyal pos0)byugs pa dang / de rgyal po'ishesgo'i bar du song ste/ phyin nas nan gyis rgyal po'i pho brang gi nang du 'gro bar 'dod pa dang /de nas rgyal po'i blon po dang / 'khor gyis de bzung nas rnam pa mang pos brdegs ji)pa dang / de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na mi dbul po de nan gyis nang du 'gro 'dod do zhes rgyal pos thos nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ gdon mi za bar nga rinaril gsod 'dod pa zhig yin no/ /snyam nas rgyal po khros te 'khor rnams la 'di skad ces khyed deng la mi de ri khrod du khrid de sod cig /g.yog dang ske/ pha ma dang / bu dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa thams cad kyang sod cig /ces bsgo ba dang / de nas de dag thams cad bsad nas de'i gnyen bshes (7)thams cad mya ngan gyi zug rngu mi bzad pas zug par gyur pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 8)chos bshad pa dang / de na mi nga rgyal can ji lta ba de bzhin du byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams de bzhin gshegs pa la gzugs dang / kha dog dang / mtshan 99)dang / dbyibs dang / mtshan mar bzung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus yin pa snyam du sems shing de na de dag chos mang po thos nas lhag pa'i nga rgyal du lhung ste kyal pa 1 risna tshogs smra ba dang / bdag tu 'dzin 48wa 638

pa dang / bdag giramanya)'dzin pa'i zil gyis non nas bdag nyid 'di lta bu'i chos mi nyan mi 'chad de/ gang la la zhig mdo'am/ tshigs su bcad pa'am/tha na dpe tsam zhig de dag la bshad na yang nga bdag tshagis shes so zhes de dag la mi 'dzin cing rna bas5 /kyang mi nyan gto/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar nga rgyal can du gyur pa'i phyir te/ de dag ni mang du thos pas bag med pa'o/ /gang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams dang 'grogs pa de dag ni 'di lta bu'i chos dang ldan pa byed par mi 'gyur/ de dag ni 'di lta bu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshig thos par mi 'gyur gyi de dag ni de)mang du thos pa des rgyags par 'gyur te/ mi de lta bu de dag ni rang gi rang bzor byas pa 'jog par byed/ rang gi gzhung gi gleng gzhi yang 'jog par byed do/ /de dag ni bdag dang 'jig rten thams cad la slu zhing don med par yul 'khor gyi bsod snyoms mang po zas7)ste zos nas kyang legasalgepar 'ju bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe 'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sems can de dag gis de la smras pa/ khyod kyis ni nga la bzo'i gnas mang du bslabs she na ji ltar khyod bdag 'jog par mi nus / des hu )de dag nyunyul 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag nga ni da ltar bdag 'jog par mi nus so/ /de na sems can de dag smre sngags rnam pa sna tshogs 'don par 'gyur te/ ji ltar gzhan gyis ma lan gyis 12rang gi las kyi rkyen gyis gang zag de gcig pu'i phyir gnyen gyi tshogs mang po bsad nyi par gyur pa de bzhin du sems can de dag kyang 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe smre sngags 'don cing mi dge ba'i grogs po'i phyir bdag cag sems can dmyal ba'am dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gzhol bar mthong ngo / /de bzhin du khyed 7rnams la bram ze dang /48wa 639

gzhan mu stegs tsho1/can rnams kyis smras pa/ khyed cag rgyags par ma gyur cig /'di lta ste/ dper na bya 'dab gshog5kyim rdzogs par lha'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i phyir nam mkha' la 'phur mi nus pa de bzhin du khyed rnams kyang mya ngan las 'das pa thob par mi nus te khyed cag la de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lasamacho zhenakyi rnam pas bya gag gi skye gnas su skyes nas7lus 'di ring po mi thogs par lus 'jig cing mthar 'chi55)bar 'gyur te/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe de dag ro bro ba med nas bdag cag gis lus 'di ci zhig gi phyir bzung /bdag cag gis gang lha'i 'jig rten gyi bde ba dang / mi'i 'jig rten gyi bde ba yang ma myong la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas la yang gnas par ma gyur te/bdag cag gis lus 'di ni don med par bzung na bdag cag gi 'gro ba ni gang yin / bdag cag7gi rten du ni su zhig 'gyur/ gang du skye zhing gang du 'jig57par 'gyur zhig gu snyam nas yongs su skrag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan mu stegs7can spyodam1)pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu dang gcer bu pa de dag la bka' stsal pa/ khyed cag rin po che'i 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yi chad par ma byed cig /khyed chos dkon mchog las phyi rol tu ma gyur cig /kye grogs po dag khyed de bzhin gshegs pa la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang /ngas khyed kyi tshibasam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas bram ze dang gzhan mu stegs can spyod57pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa de dag thams cad stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gdugs mtshan du sems can rnams 'khor ba las yongs su bkrol yang 48wa 640

sems can gyi khams la bri ba'am gang bar yang mi ①gda' na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis sems can de dag skye ba dang / 'gag pa mnyam par ston/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la bka' stsal pa/ mu stegs can dag 'gyod pa chen po bsal ba dang / chos kyi sgron ma chen po 'bar bar bya ba'i phyir go cha chen po bgos nas 'dri ba'i glengakhugazhi chen po 'dri ste/ phyi ma'i dus na sems can57gzhon nu dang / rgan po rnams skye ba dang 'jig pa shes57par 'gyur55)ro/ /sman gyi sde sems can rgan po dag kyang gzhon nu bzhin du ci yang mi shes pa yang yod do/ /sman gyi sde 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu la la zhig spa bkrus9)nas gos gsar ⑧pa bgos te/ de khyim gyi phyi rol tu byung ba de la sems 7can rnams kyis khyod gos gsar pa legs par bgos so zhes smras pa dang / sems can gzhan zhig kyang mgo bkrus nas gos rnying pa yang bkrus te bgos pa dang de zegs pas mi de spa bkrus51kyang mdzes par ma gyur la/ de'i gos kyang mdzes par ma gyur pa de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde 'dzam bu'i gling na sems can rgan po yod pa dag ni mdzes pa ma yin te/ sems can gzhon nu dag ni skye ba dang 'gag pa ston to/ /de nas 8bram ze dang gzhan mu stegs can spyod 32pa pa dang /kun tu rgyu de dag thams cad stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi nang na gzhon nu ni gang lags / rgan po7ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyed cag ni7yang dang yang sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams su tshor ba myong yang khyedamo da dung du ngoms nyi mi myong bas khyed cag 48wa 641

ni rgan pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bram ze de dag thams cad dang /klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slan chad 'khor bar sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba la mi spro'o/ /gang tshigazhan mu stegs can spyodas pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa rnams kyis 'di skad ces smras 5)so/ /sems can gzhon nu rnams las kyang gang chos nyid mngon sum du 4)byed nus pa med do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du sems can rnams mos pa dka' ba la gzigs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig dngas3)de bzhin gshegs pas ni 'jig rten thams cad mngon sum du mdzad done/ /de nas sems can gzhon nu bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa bzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'dug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag kyang mi 'tshal tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can 'di dag bcom ldan 'das la mi smra/ kun tu mi smra zhing phyag kyang mi 'tshal/bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba yang mi bgyid pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig /sems can gzhon nu rnams kyis chos nyid mngon sum du byed mi nus so/ /zhes sems can gang de skad zer ba la/ sman gyi sde 'di dag ni khyed kyis sems can gzhon nu yin par blta'o ri/ /sems can de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni sems can gzhon nu lags so/ /btsun pa 48—642

bde bar gshegs pa bdag cag ni sems can gzhon nu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye sems can 'di dag ni 'jig rten mngon sum du byed pa yin gyis/ da0)rang gi lus las 'jig rten gyi tshad ston cig /de'i tshe de'i dus na sems can gzhon nu bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa bzhi lus dang ma bral bar steng gi nam mkha' la gnas te/ sa bcu rab tu thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdesashe'adi skad ces gsol to/ /gang dag 'khor ba yongs su zad par bgyi bas ridang yongs su byang bar bgyi ba'i slad du brtson 'grus rtsom5gepa'i sems can de lta bu ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can 'di dag ni deng nyid skyes la/ bcom ldan 'das sems can 'di dag ni deng nyid yongs su grol te thams cad kyang sa bcu rab tu thob par mthong ngo // //bam po gsum pa/ de nas bram ze dang / gzhan mu stegs can spyod 3)pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa dang / klu'i rgyal po dang / bdud sdig can 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad lhags nas g.yo bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du mchis te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas bdag cag gis sangs rgyas kyi bde ba 'di lta bu thob par gyur cig /'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di lta bur gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs 6)dag de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du lhags nas khyed kyis zung gisamachos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 48—643

pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ / des natshamakhyed thams cad ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig 'di gsungs ma thag tu/de nas gzhan mu stegs can de dag thams cad mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur te(mi/ thams cad kyang sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpar gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad steng gi nam mkha' bar snang la shing ta la bdun srid du mngon par 'phags nas rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegasalgepa dag de bzhin gshegs pa la dbul zhing thams cad kyang rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs byin gyis rlob ste rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu'i spyi gtsug gi steng logs su gnas te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog sil ma sna tshogs 'thor zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang yid la byed de/ rang gi lus la yang sangs rgyas su 'du shes bskyed do/ /lha'i bu bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma yang de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par 'thor zhing tshig 'di skad du dge sbyong gi ta ma ni rnyed pa chen po'o/ /zhing chen po'o/ /'jig rten gyi mgon no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa brnyes pa'o/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa tshol7ba lags te/gang sems can 'di lta bu dag thabs mkhas pas mthar gyis 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar mdzad de legs par gsungs pa gcig tsam gyis kyang sems can de snyed cig 'khor ba las yongs su grol lo zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde stan las langs nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom 48—644

ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldanatu'adas rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis rigs kyi bu de dag tshig 'di skad 'byin cing rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bgyi ba mang7po bgyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa mang po mngon par 'du bgyid/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nyon cig /de dag ni nga la bstod7pa ma yin gyi/ rang gi lus la bstodarabacing rang gi lus chos kyi stan dam pa la 'jog par 'gyur/ rang gi lus las chos kyi 'od zer 'byin par 'gyur / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kyang chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa gdugs mtshan du sems can mang po zhig yongs su grolasnyeyang da dung du sems can rnams zad par ma gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / sman gyi sde khyod gang de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /sman gyi sde 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu la la zhig phyug cing nor che la longs spyod che ste/ nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang /bangasab mang po dang ldan la/ bran po dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang ske/ zho shas 'tsho ba'i mi mang po dang ldan te/ de nor gyi phung po mang la zhing dang kun dga'i77ra ba mang du bdog cing / 'di lta ste/ nas dang / gro dang ske/ 'bras dang / bal sran dang / sran chung la sogs pa 'bru mang du 48—645

bdog pa zhig yod la/ mi des dpyid kyi dusashel 'bru thams cad kyi sa bon btab nas dus gzhan zhig gi tshe sa bon de dag thams cad yongs su smin par gyur pa dang / mi des 'bru de dang de dag so sor 'jog ste/ bzhag rinanas kyang dpyid kyi dus kyi bar du zos nas yang 'debs pa bzhin du sman gyi sde sems can rnams kyang sngon las byas pa'i las de dag thams cad yongs su zad par gyur pa chos dang / de la bsod nams kyi zhing tshol ④te dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed do/ /bskyed nas kyang dge ba'i chos de la nan tan gyis sgrub ste chos thams cad 'phel bar byas nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba bskyed de/ sman gyi sde dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems des bskal pa bye ba'i bar du chud mi za'o/ /sman gyi sde de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba chud za 55)ba'i chos can du nam yang mi 'gyur te/ mdor na chos thams cad rab tu shes so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i 4)mi lam ji lta bu mthong bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i rmi lam du 'jigs pa mang po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ las thams cad yongs su sbyongasheba'i phyir ro/ /sems can sdig pa'i las can gyis ni sdug bsngal mi bzad zhu)pa sel bar mi nus so/ /de ni sdig pa'i rmi lam mthong yang 'jigs pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i mi lam du ji ltar 'jigs pa mthong bar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde me rab tu 'bar ba mthong ste/ desngo'onas byang chub sems dpa' des hu stabadag gis nyon mongs pa 48wa 646

thams cad tshig par rig par bya'o/ /sman gyi sde gnyis su ni7byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa des chu brug ②cing rab tu brug pa mthong yang 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sman gyi sde de bzhin du gti mug gis7bcings pa thams cad las bzlog54)nas sdig pa byang bar byas pa yin no/ /sman gyi sde gsum du na gebyang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i mi ga byelam na 'jigs pa chen po mthong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bdag gi7lus kyi mgo bregs pa mthong yang sman gyi sde de la des 'jigasalgepar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/bdag gi 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug bregs pa yin te/bdag ni 'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba las rgyal ba yin no snyam mo/ /de sems can dmyal bar gnas pa yang ma yin/ dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams kyi nang du ma yin/ lha ma yin rnams kyi nang du ma yin/ klu rnams kyi nang du ma yin/lha rnams kyi nang du ma yin te/ sman gyi sde byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams su skye ba rab tu 'dzin to//sman gyi sde phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na gal te sems can la la zhig byang chub tu sems yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur na des yi dam chen po bcas par blta ste/brnyas par gnas par gyur kyang sman gyi sde de la des sir+sha)skyo ba'i sems bskyed par mi bya/ zhum par mi bya'o/ /sman gyi sde ngas chos mang du bstan te/ sman gyi sde ngas bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma zhig gi hu sdubar du dka' ba spyod pa spyad kyang sman gyi sde ngas longs spyod kyi phyir ram/ 'tsho ba'i longs spyod kyi phyir ram / dbang phyug gi longs spyod kyi phyir dka' ba spyod pa spyad pa ma yin gyi/48wa 647

sman gyi sde chos kyi ngo bo nyid khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir ngas dka' ba spyod pa spyad kyang ngas de srid kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi/ sman gyi sde gang gi tshe gang gi dus na ngas zung gi kwa/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa de nyid kyi nyin mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sman gyi sde chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zab bo/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa rnyed par dka'o/ sman gyi sde de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ba yang mchog tu rnyed par dka'o/ /sman gyi sde chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dag kyang mchog tu rnyed par dka'o/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa de dag thams cad ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde bskal pa〈stong du 'khor bsnyebasnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rab tu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'gog pa dang lam yang rab tu shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnas rab tu shes pa'i skal bsayod par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i gnas rab tu shes pa'i skal ba yod par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa dang dge ba'i gnas rab tu shes pa'i skal ba yod par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i gnas dang 'gog pasarab tu shes pa'i skal ba ༅yod par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde ci'i phyir 'gog pa zhes bya/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi gnas ni don zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde chos kyi gnas gang yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos zhes bgyi ba ni brtson 'grus brtsams pa nyid dang / tshul khrims bsrungs pasanyid dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa lags te/ chos kyi gter zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 48—648

'di ni chos kyi gter 'byung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka'7stsal pa/sman gyi sde de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde gang dag mang du thos pa dang ldan pa/ rab tu shes pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'byung ba shes nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'byung ba bde ba'i gnas 'di rab tu shes so/ /nam de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ba de na sems can rnams kyis chos thams cadakurab tu shes so/ /thabs mkhas pas chos rnams rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten pashedang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes rnams rab tu shes so/ /gsol pa/ ye shes nyid rtogs nas mya ngan las 'das pa gang rab tu 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde chos rab tu shes nas chos rab tu shes so/ /sman gyi sde de bzhin du dam pa'i chos bsdu b.rasnyirab tu shes nas rnyed pa dang po skye'o/ /chos ji ltar thos pa bzhin du bzung nas chos dang ldan pa nyid rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde 'di lta ste/ dper na mi tshong par gyur pa la la zhig mi khur stong gi gser khyer te de khe spogs kyi phyir song ba dang / de'i pha ma 'di skad smra ⑥ste/ bu nyon cig gser mesung stong khyer la gzhan dang rang gi gser legs par khyer cig /tshong pa des gser khyer te song nas zla ba gcig tsam lon pa dang gser de dag thams cad chud gsan te med par byas kyi 'og tu de nas mi des bsamasalgepa dang shin 48—649

tu mi dga' 1nas snying la mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug ste de la (miganong zhing ngo tsha nas rang gi khyim du ma song ba dang / de'i pha mas thos nas yi〈kyechad de/ snying la mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug nas gos dag kyang dral te bu ngan pa de bdag cag gi khyim du bu'i gzugs su skyes nas khyim so kun kyang bshig ste/ bdag cag la mkho ba med cing sdug bsngal bar byas so/ /bran gyi las byed du bcug go zhes de skad smre sngags 'don te/ de'i pha ma yi chad nas 'chi ba'i dus byas pa dang /de nas bu des pha ma bdag la yi chad de 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /zhes thos nas bu de yang yi chad de 'chi ba'i dus byas pa de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde de bzhin gshegs pas don 'di bshad pa la yang gang dag nga'i bstan pa la mi dad pa de dag ni re thag chad nas 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe snying la mya ngan gyi gezug rngus zug ste 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar pha ma de dag yi chad de gser gyi phyir mya ngan byed cing / snying la mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug nas gzhan dang rang gi gser gyi phyir mya ngan gyi zug rngu dang ldan pa de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde gang dag nga'i bstan pa la ma dad pa de dag ni phyis 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe brang brdung5gezhing smre sngags 'don la/ sdug bsngal 45)gyi tshor ba myong zhing sngon las byas pa'i bsod nams dag chud zos nas phyin chad tshezhing bzang po dang ldan pa'i bsod nams dag mi byed de/ de dag gi snying mya ngan gyi zug rngu dang ldan pas de'i tshe de'i dus na sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye zhing / mi bzad pa drag po mthong nas 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe 'di snyam du sems te/ gang sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten mthong bar mi 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal gyi 48wa 650

tshor ba de myong bar mi 'gyur bar bdag la su zhig skyabs su 'gyur snyam pa dang /de'i pha mas 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu cig nad kyi 'jigs chen ni/ /'byung bar mi nus ji ltar bya/ /na ba 'chi bas 'jigs mod kyi/ /bu khyod 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /nad kyis 'jigs dang skrag pa las/ /khyod ni thar bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bdag ni0)rnam par shes pa 'gag /bdag gi lus la rab tu gnod / /yan lag thams cad sdug bsngal te/ /bdag gis 'chi ba mthong bar gyural / /bdag gis memig ni mi mthong zhing / /bdag gi rna7yang mi thos so /sna yang thob par mi 'gyur te/ /lus kyang zo mdogatsobade ma yin/ /yan lag nying lag sdug bsngal te/ /shing dang 'dra bas sems pa med/ /bdag gi 'chi ba 'ong med ces⑥/ /yum gyis bdag gi spro bsring zad/ /mas57smras pa/ bu khyod de skad smra mi rigs/ /ngapo)la mchog tu 'jigs ma byed/ /khyod kyi lus la rims btab pas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mthong bar 'gyur6)/ /bus smras pa/lus la rims kyang ma mthong ste/ /na ba med cing sdug bsngal med/ /'chi ba shin tu mi bzad mthong / /bdag gi lus sdug bcom par gyur/ /bdag gi lus kun sdug bsngal gyis/ /rab tu gzir bar mthong gyur na/ /su la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ /bdag gi skyob par su zhig 'gyur/ /pha mas smras pa bu khyod la / /lha yang rab tu bkyon nya gyur gyis3skyo/ /lha rnams la ni mchod byas na/ /de yi 'og tu 'tsho bar gyuranyuge/ /bus smras pa/ gang gis bdag ni 'tsho 'gyur ba / /khyod kyis de ltar mdzad du gsol/ /rings shing rab tu myur bzhud la/ /lha bon po la dri bar gsol/lhe/ /de nas de'i pha ma lha'i rten gyi drung du song nas lha la bdug patsha8phul ba dang / de nas lha bon pos lha la bdug pa phul nas/48—651

tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod la lha bkyon gyis7)lha rjedakucig /mchod sbyin gyis shig /de la phyugs sod cig /mi yang sod cig dang / de nas khyed kyi bu nad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas pha ma de dag gis bsams5zhe ripal/ bdag cag ni dbul〈pen ji ltar bya/ gal te lha ma mnyes na ni bu de yang 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur/ ji5geste mnyes par bya na bdag cag ni dbul bas mi dang phyugs gang nas blang snyam nas de dag rings shing myur bar khyim du dong ste/ khyim gyi rdzas cung zad ci bdog pa de thams cad phyugs nyo ba'i phyir 'tshong55)du dong ngo / /de nas mi gzhan zhig gi gan du phyin nas/ kye skyes bu gser zhig skyir ༅byin skyin pa ni zhag bcu nas slar 'bul nus na ni legs/ji 2)ste 'bul ma nus na yang nged khyed 7kyi bran du khas blangs te las bya'o/ /zhes de skad smras nas de gnyis kyis gser de khyer te mi nyor dong ngo / /de gnyis kyis mi nyos nas mi des kyang bdag bsadarwaste par ni ma shes so/ /de nas pha ma rmongs par gyur pa de gnyis slar rang gi khyim du ma dong gi lha rten gyi drung du song ste/ lha bon po la da myur du mchod sbyin mdzod cig ces smras so/ /de nas pha ma de gnyis bdag nyid kyis phyugs kyang bsad mi de yang bsad do/ /de nas lha bon po des mchod sbyin bya bar bsams te me nyi bus pa dang / de nas lha de babs te khyod kyi bu ni ngas khyer ro zhes smras so/ /de nas pha ma de gnyis dga' zhing mgu bas khyab (rtenas bu 'di sos na bdag cag bran du gyur kyang bla zhes smras te / pha mas lha la mchod sbyin byas nas slar log ste rang gi khyim du phyin nas bu 'chi ba'i dus byas pa mthong ngo / /de nas pha ma de gnyis sdug bsngal zhing yicamug pa chen pos snying la mya ngan gyi zug rngu zug ste yi chad par gyur nas de nyid du 48—652

'chi ba'i dus byas pa de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde mi dge ba'i grogs po dang bsten par mi bya'o①/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can de dag gang du skye ba zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde kha rog ngardzobal ma 'dri shig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zhu'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde de la ma ni sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod du skyes so/ /pha ni sems can dmyal ba chen po bsdus gzhom du skyes so/ /bu ni sems can dmyal ba chen po tsha bar skyes so/ /lha bon po ni sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skyes so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mi ma nongs pa de gang du skyes de'i tshe slad ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde ga'adi la mi ma nyesalgepa de ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis mi de sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang skal brkumanyam par skyes / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig /mi de 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa la sems dad pas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes lan cig smras te/ sman gyi sde dge ba'i rtsa ba des bskal pa drug cu'i bar du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal pa brgyad cu'i bar du skye bar tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ skye ba dang skye bar mya ngan gyi zug rngu thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes ma thag tu sdug bsngal thams cad zlog par byed do/ /sems can de dag thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla7bar ni mi nus so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzladzadabyebar rngo thogs 7)pa lags/ bcom 48—653

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus brtsam pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig /brtson 'grus zhesang 19bya ba ni 'bras bu rnams ston pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu 'gag pa zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i shes pa zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'bras bu dang / byang chub kyi gnas zhes nabya ba ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas te/ sman gyi sde 'di dag ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas zhes dbya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyun du zhugs pa dang ske/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ji ltar bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig gis shing zhig bskyed na de nyid kyi nyin mo shing de'i rtsa ba zug nas de nyid kyi nyin mo rtsa ba de ril dpag tshad tsam gyi 'og tu song ngo / /mi gzhan zhig gis kyang de bzhin du shing bskyed pa dang / de nyid kyi nyin mo rlung gis bskyod de shing de rtsa ba ma zug nas/de nas mi des gnas de nas 5shing de phyung ba dang / mi cig shos kyis kyang ci'i phyir nga'i sa brkos zhes 6'thab 'breg rtsod par gyur nas/ de'i tshe rgyal pos mi de rimariganyis 'thab 'breg rtsod par gyur to/ /zhes thos nas/ rgyal po des rishepho nya btang ste/ song la mi de gnyis khrid de shog shig /lha de ltar 'tshal lo zhes 48wa 654

mi de rings pa'i gzugs su brgyugs nas mi de gnyis la 'di skad ces khyed la rgyal po 'bod do zhes smras pa dang / de nas mi gcig ni 'jigs shing skrag go/ /mi gcig ni 'jigs shing skrag pa med par rgyal po ga 11la ba der khrid do/ /khrid nas rgyal po'i mdun du 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal pos mi de gnyis la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye khyed ci zhig gi phyir 'thab cing rtsod par gyur/ de nas mi de gnyis langs te rgyal po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po gsan du gsol / bdag cag la ni sa phyogs cung zad kyang ma mchis kyi sa nagayar po zhig la shing bskyed pa las rlung gis bskyod 45)nas rtsa ba yang ma zug lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu yang ma byung ste/ rgyal po chen po de'i rtsa ba dpag tshad tsam gyi 'og tu yang mchis pa dang / khyod kyis nyes so zhes mi 'dis bdag la thab mo brgal du bas kyi bdag gis ni cam nongs na lha de la bdag gis 5cung zad kyang ma nongs par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ de nas rgyal po des blon po bye ba phrag sum cu bkug ste/ bsogs phyinas 'di skad ces bsgo'o/ /khyed 7cag sgros shig /blon po rnams kyis gsol pa/ ji skad smra bar bgyi/ gang gi nyin mo shing bskyed pa de nyid kyi nyin mo rtsa ba zug nas lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu 'byung ba de 8)khyed kyis gang na yang mthong ngam/ thos sam khyed kyis zhag bdun nam zla ri9)phyed kyis 'di bye brag phyed par gyis shig /de nas blon po de dag stan las langs te rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po bdag cag gis 'di bye brag phyed par bgyir mi rung ngo / /'di bye brag phyed par rngo mi thogs so3 )/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ni ngo mtshar te/ re shig mi 'di nyid la rma 3nyabar bgyi'o/ /kye skyes bu gang smras pa'i don bden nam smos shig /smras pa 48—655

rgyal po chen po don de mad gyo)do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gang gi nyin mo shing bskyed pa/ /de yi nyin mo mdzabazug cing / /'dab ri ma me tog 'bras byung zhes//de nyid nyin mo smra ba ni/ /khyod kyi7tshig 'di 'thad par dka'/ /'di 'dra mthong ba'am thos pa med/ /de nas mi des thal sbyar te/ rgyal po de la 'di skad smras/ /gshegs la nyid kyis shing bskyed de/ /rtsa ba zug la gzigs su gsol / /de nas rgyal po de blon po bye ba phrag sum cu dang lhan cig phyi rol tu byung nas mi de gnyis kyang btsona'abarar bcug go/ /de nas rgyal po de nyid kyis shing bskyed pa dang / shing de rtsa ba yang ma zug /lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu yang ma byung nas de nas rgyal po de khros te 'di skad ces khyed myur du deng la shing gshegs pa'i5nyusta re rnams long57)shig /ces smras nas blangs pa dang ske/ de nas gang mi des bskyed pa'i shing de la khros nas shing de'i lo ma dang /me tog dang / 'bras bu byung ba rnams bcad de shing gcig po de bcad pa dang shing bcu gnyis byung ngo / /shing bcu gnyis po bcad pa52skadang / rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rtsa ba dang bcas/ lo ma dang bcas/ myu gu dang bcas pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ngo / /de nas shing nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de dag las bya gser gyi zerwa)ba can / gser gyi mchu can/ rin po che sna bdun gyi 'dabarka )ma can nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po de khro ba'i zil gyis non nas rang gi lag gis sta re blangs te shing de la gtsabs pa dang / shing gtsabs pa de las bdud rtsi'i chu byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po de yid mi bde nas song la mi de gnyis btson ra nas phyung shig ces bsgo ba dang / lha de ltar 'tshal lo zhes de'i med la rab tu brgyugs te/ mi de gnyis btson ra nas phyung nas shing ga la ba der khrid pa dang /48—656

rgyal pos smras pa/ shing gcig bcad pa gnyis gyur ①du 'phel te nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur pa de khyed kyis bskyed dam/ ngas bskyed pa'i shing ni rtsa ba dang /lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu yang ma skyes so/ /de nas mi des gsol pa / rgyal po chen po bdag gi bsod nams ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i bsod nams khyod la mi mnga'o/ /de nas blon po bye ba phrag sum cus pus mo'i lha nga gnyis57sa la btsugs nas mi de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po snga ma 'di ni mi rung gis khyodasakyis rgyal po bya dgos so/ /de nas mi des blon po de dag la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal po longs spyod bdag mi dgos/ /nor dang 'bru yang dgos pa med/ /sangs rgyas rnams la bdag dad pas(pe/ /rkang gnyis dag gi byamachog tu shog /zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings/ /gang na de bzhin gshegs par 'gro/ /mya ngan 'das khyim 'gro 'gyur ba/ /chos 'di khyed la bshad par bya/ / skyil mo krung 46)ni bcas nas su/ /de nas yi dam rab bcas so/ /bdag gis sngon byas las rnams kyis/ /rgyal po'i btson〈perar phyin par gyurame/ /smon lam 'di ni btab pas na/ /bdag gi las ni zad par gyur/ /de nas bya bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhis rdo rje'i mchus sil snyan rnams dkrol to/ /de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na khang pa brtsegs pa sum khri nyis stong byung ste / khang pa brtsegs pa re re'i tshad kyang dpag tshad nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re re las kyang bya gser gyi ze ba can/ gser gyi mchu can gser gyi gdong can bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga byung ste/ de dag gis mi'i skad du smras pa/ rgyal po khyod kyis legs ma hu 3byas/ /khyod kyis shing de bcad pas na / /bye ba brgya yi shing rnams las/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas par gyur/ /48—657

sems can gang gis shing bskyed 'di/ /ci 'dra shes pa ma yin pa/ /sdig pa'i las kyis phyin chad kyang1/ /mi sdug 'bras bu myong bar 'gyur/ /rgyal pos smras pa / bdag gis don 'di mi shes kyis / /dka' thub chen po lung ston cig /bya rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di ni 'jig rten snang byed de/ /rnam par 'dren par 'gyur ba yin/ /'khor ba'i srid pa'i btson ra las/ /sems can thams cad thar byed pa'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gang gis )shing ni ma skyes pa/ /skyes bu gnyis pa de gang yin/ /des ni sdig pa'i las gang byas/ /gnyis skyes rnams ni smra bar 'byos/ /bya rnams kyis smras pa/ gang gi shing ni ma skyes pa/ /de ni lha sbyin glen pa 6riste/ /dge ba cung zad ma byas na/ /de yi shing ni ji ltar skye la/ /de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na blon po bye ba phrag sum cu po rnams kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas thams cad kyang 8snas bcu la rab tu gnas te/mngon par shes pa so sor thob par gyur to/ /rgyal po de yang sa bcu la gnas nas dge ba'i chos mngon par rtogs pa rjes su thob bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis blon po bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gsum po rnams sa bcu la gnas te/ mngon par shes pa so sor thob par gyur / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig dang lung bstan par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad sheXdo/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog du ma kha dog sna tshogs / kha dog brgya stong phrag du ma 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan nyu dang / shel dang / dngul gyi 48—658

kha dog lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong byung nas de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' tshoniyas mu med pa snang bar byas te/ slar log nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nadabu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de(ba/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis/ rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas skye bo'i tshogs nga'i nga gan du 'ong ba mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde de'i phyir skye bo'i tshogs la rnam par rtogs te ltos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes rnam par bltas pa dang / shar phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa cig byung nas/ de'i phyogs gcig nas yeskye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/ mi dag mi smra/ mi zer/ mi brjod/ mi za/ mi ldang / mi 'chag ste/ cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / lho phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa cig byung nas de la skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/ de dag kyang mi zer mi smra/ kun tu mi smra/ yongs su mi brjod/ mi ldang / mi 'chag ste/cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / nub phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa 48—659

cig byung nas de la skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/ de dag kyang mi zer/ mi smra/ kun tu mi smra/ yongs su mi brjod/ mi ldang / mi 'chag ste / cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / byang phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa cig byung nas/ de la skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/de dag kyang mi zer mi smra/ kun tu mi smra/ yongs su mi brjod/ mi ldang /mi 'chag ste/ cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / 'og gi phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa cig byung nas de la skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/ de dag kyang mi zer/ mi smra/ kun tu mi smra/ yongs su mi brjod/mi ldang / mi 'chag ste/ cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / steng gi phyogs nas shing dpag tshad bdun stong pa cig byung nas/ de la skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te/ de dag kyang mi zer/ mi smra/ kun tu mi smra/yongs su mi brjod/ mi ldang / mi 'chag ste/ cang mi smra bar 'khod pa mthong ngo ske/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi sde ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi tshote sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman 48—660

gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten nas skye bo'i tshogs mang po lhags shing gnas pa nas 'og dang steng phyogs kyi bar nas skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag lnga bcu lhags shing gnas par gyur pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / sman gyi sde khyod song la 'di dag 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas lhags pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la khyod nyid kyis zhus shig /gsol pa/ su'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pas mchi bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed par song shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug 'das te/ 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba de na7de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla ba can gyi zhing zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba stong phrag brgyad cus yongs su bskor cing mdun7gyis bltas nas chos ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba can gyi zhing de'i spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang gis mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar skye bo'i〈tshogs phyogs bcu nas 'dus shing lhags pa dag de narmetshomachis pa'i tshe ni mthong la 'di na mchis pa'i tshe mi mthong bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 48—661

bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde de nyid na rgyu zhing gnas so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang ji lta bu lags/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba can gyi zhing ga la ba der song ste phyin nas de bzhin gshegs pa de'i spyan sngar 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug 'das te mchis pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de dag tu sems can ji snyed mthong ba de snyed ni gang na yang ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can de dag ni sems pa med pa'i shing las byung ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang sems pa ma mchis pa'i shing las ni nya)byung ba sus mthong sus dathos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde gang sems pa med pa'i shing las mi 'byung ba khyod kyis ma mthong ma thos sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ma mthong ma thos so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde khyod mthong bar 'dod na deng ༷ngas bstan par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'tshal lo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba can gyi zhing nas phyag rkyang ba ca dang phyag de las skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag brgya byung ste/ skye bo'i tshogs re res kyang lag lde)pa brgya brgya brkyang neranas spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa sna tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa la gtor ba dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde khyod kyis skye bo'i tshogs 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa la spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa gtor ba mthong ngamachi / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /48—662

bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/skye bo'i tshogs byung ba 'di dag ni tsho15sems pa med pa'o/ /mi 'di dag ni sems pa med pa'o/ /de nas mi (bye ba stong phrag brgya po de dag re re zhing yang gang lags pa brgya brgya yod pa de dag thams cad lhung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi pa sdes de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ci zhig lags/ bde bar gshegs pa 'di ci zhig lags/ gang mi rnams kyi lag pa brgya 5)po yang yud tsam gyis lhung ste/ bcom ldan 'das gal te lag pa brgya pa yang grol bar mi 'gyur na/ lag pa gnyis pa'i mi lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde de bzhin du sems can rnams ni sems pa med par skye'o/ /sems pa med par 'gag 6go/ /sman gyi sde de'i lus kyang sems pa nimed par gyur par shes par bya'on/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang sems can de dag la gzhon pa gang lags/ rgan pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde sems can gzhon pa yang yod/ rgan pa yang yod doshe / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gzhon pa gang lags/ rgan pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag da 13 ltar lhung ba 911de dag ni rgan pa'o/ /gang dag shing rnams las skyes pa de dag ni gzhon pa'o / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gzhon nu rnams mthong bar 'tshal lo/ / de nas 12de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba can gyi zhing gis phyag g.yas pa'i mthil brkyang ba 1lhadang / de nas phyogs bcu 14nas skye bo'i tshogs bye ba stong phrag brgya brgya 'ong ngo / /'og dang steng gi phyogs nas skye bo'i tshogs bye ba 48—663

phrag lnga bcu lnga bcumanyu'ong ste/ skye bo'i tshogs de dag lhags nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi rin/zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalamakyenas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mi smra/ kun tu mi smra zhing cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mi smra/ kun tu'umi smra zhing cang mi mchi bar mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde khyod mi shes sam/ sa phyogs ni sems pa med de mi smra/ kun tu7mi smra zhing chos kyi phung po yang mi shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / sman gyi sde 'di la sems can gzhon nu kha cig ni mthong yang skye ba mi shes/'gag pa dang / rga ba dang / nad dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa dang / mdza' ba7)dang ske/ bye ba dang / 'chi ba dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / sdug bsngal mi bzad7pa de dag thams cad mi shes te/ mthong yang yid 'byung bar mi 'gyur na shes par lta ga la 'gyur te/ sman gyi sde de dag yang dang yang bslab par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes spu)'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang chos ma 'tshal ba'i sems can gzhon nu de dag gang nas mchis3 )/ gang nas 'chi 'pho zhing gang du skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig /mi'i lus yongs su 'dzin pa de dag ni nyunyadangul mkhan gyis kyang ma byas / zangs mkhan gyis kyang ma byas/ shing mkhan gyis kyang ma byas/ rdza mkhan gyis kyang ma byas te/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pas kyang ma byas kyi/ gzhan du 48wa 664

na skyes pa dang bud med 'dus pa dang sdig pa'i las dang ldan pa las byung ngo / /sems can de dag kyang yang dang yang bzo'i las rnams slob pas de dag gi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa mtha' yas pa dang / tshor ba mi bzad pa 'byung ste/ der de dag sngon sdig pa mi dge ba'i las byas pa'i rnam par smin pa myong ngo / /sman gyi sde 'di nyid du gang sems can gzhon nu lhags pa mi ldang ba 'di dag ni 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong bar 'gyur te/ sman gyi sde de'i phyir mi smra/kun tunyemi smra'o/ /sman gyi sde de ltar na sems can gzhon nu de dag ni dge bsngogeyang mi shes/ skye ba yang mi shes/ 'gag pa yang mi shes te/ de dag mi'i⑧lus kyang 'thob par mi 'gyur ba 'di dag kyang sman gyi sde sems can gzhon nu rnams zhes ④bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gzhon nu rnams ji ltar skye/ ji ltar 'gag /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig gis me la shing gis reg par byas pa dang /shing de la mthar gyis me 'bar ba de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde thog ma mi'i lus su skye'o / /skyes nas gdod tshor ba myong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das su zhig 'dir mngon par skyelta/ skyes nas su zhig yongs su mya ngan las 'das/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde sangs rgyas nyid skyes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /'di lta ste dper na/rgyal pos mi la la zhig bcings te khang pa mun pa mun nag gi nang du btson rar bcug pa dang / mi de khang pa mun nag der zhugs nas khang pa mun nag la khang pa mun nag tu mthong ngo / /de nas mi gzhan sngon56)sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas reg pa zhig gis mthong nas mi de ni ma rung b.ram gyur to/ /sngon sdug bsngal ma myong 48—665

bas 'tsho ba srog chad par 'gyur ro/ /snyam bsams tsho1nas des pader me khyer te 'ongs nas khyim de'i nang du me chung 45)zad cig bor ba dang / mi btson rar bcug pa des me de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dbugs phyin par gyur te spro ba skyes so/ /me de yang rgyu gang gis 'bar ba'i me 'bar ba des khyim de kun tu 'bar bar gyur nas mi de yang de nyid du tshig pa dang / de tshig go zhes rgyal pos thos nas mi dga' ste/ de 'di snyam du phyin cad 6 ni bdag gi yul du sems can gang yang btson rar mi gzhug 45go snyam du sems 6so/ /de nas rgyal po des rang gi yul na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la/ kye sems can khyedas cag ma 'jigs shig /ma skrag shig /khyed cag 'jigs par ma gyur cig /phyin chad nga'i yul du chad pas gcad 87pa'am/ btson rar gzhug par mi bya'o//sems can gang yang srog dang dbral 9bar mi bya/ kye sems can khyed rnams ma 'jigs shig ces de ltar dbugs phyung ba de bzhin du/ sman gyi sde de bzhin gshegs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad bsregs pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'o / /ji ltar khyim tshig nas mi nyid kyi lus kyang tshig ste/ sems can rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs nas sems can bcings pa yang bcings pa las yongs su thar bar byed pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dri ma spangs te/ sems can thams cad la sgron ma bzhin du 'jig rten du byung nas sems can rnams sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin gyi lus rnams las yongs su thar bar mdzad cing sems can gzhin nu dang / rgan po rnams kyang yongs su thar bar mdzad do/ /de nas steng gi bar snang las 48wa 666

tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /rgyal ba'i zhing ni ngo mtshar zhing / /zhing bzangs tshemangon par 'dus byas pa/ /de la sa bon btab pa ni/ /rnam par chud zar〈 mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba'i zhing ni dag pa'i zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsngags pa ste/ /sems can thams cad bzung ciba'i phyir/ /ston pas kyang ni thabs mdzad do/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings gnas kyang / /sa yi steng na kun tu snang / /rtag tu 'jig rten zhi byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sbyin pa'i gnas rnams sbyong / /sems can gzhon nu thar bar byed/ /rgan po rnams kyang thar bar byed/ /sems can thams cad khams gsum las/ /mthar gyis yongs su thar bar byas/ /sems can dmyal ba'i sgo bcad de/ /dud 'gro yi dgas thar bar byas/ /'jig rten 'di yang zhi byas nas/ /'jig rten pha rol bde bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzumatsha47pa mdzad nas/ bka' stsal pa/ legs pa rnams ni mthong na legs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong na legs/ /dam chos yon tan zhing yang legs/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa mthong na legs/ /zung bstan pa yang legs pa ste/ /sdig pa rnam par 'jig pa legs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 5logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gzhon nu 'di dag mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde 'di dag thams 48—667

cad ni deng 3)nyid du sa bcu la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde dpag tshad brgyad khri srid kyi steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa dang / lha bye ba stong phrag brgyad cu bcom ldan 'das la me tog gi char rab tu 'bebs so/ /sems can gzhon nu de dag kyang thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes bar snang la gnas bzhin du tshig 'di skad ces smras te②/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams sgras gang bar gyur pa dang /sems can dmyal ba chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis su skyes pa'i sems can rnams sgra de nyan to/ /lha'i ris sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang sgra de la nyan to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i nang gi klu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang 'khrugs so/ /srin po bye ba stong phrag sum cu yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir lhags so/ /yi dgas dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga yang lcang lo can gyi pho brang 'khor nas lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dus pa chen po kun tu 'dus noso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can gzhon nu de dag la chos bstan pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba stong phrag brgya rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags so// //bam po bzhi pa ste tha ma/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar bsrebatud nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub 48wa 668

sems dpa' 'dus shing mchis pa mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das lha dang klu 'dus shing mchis pa yang mang ngo / /srin po bye ba phrag du ma zhig kyang lcang lo can gyi pho brang 'khor nas lhags te 'dus nas mchis par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mar shog /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis steng nas babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi phung po chos kyi phung po zhes bgyi ba/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na chos kyi phung po zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi phung po zhes bya ba ni gang tshangs par spyod pa yongs su tshol nya)zhing gang tshangs par spyod pa yongs su btsal nas kyang sdig pa thams cad spong ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gzhon nu mi tshangs par spyod pa spangs nas gdon mi za bar gzungs rab tu 'thob par 'gyur zhing chos thams cad dang yang ldan par 'gyur ba de dag mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thabs gang gis sems can mang po zhig 'dus shing chos kyi phung po nyan/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la bka' stsal pa / sman gyi sde gang dag skye ba nyid du ri rjesdug bsngal du mi nyan/ rga ba 4)nyid dus tshosdug bsngal du mi nyan/ nad nyid sdug bsngal dang / mya ngan sdug bsngal dang /smre sngags 'don pa sdug bsngal dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang /phyi sdug bsngal dang ske/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa sdug bsngal du mi nyan pa'i sems can yang phal 48wa 669

cher yod do1)/ /'chi ba ni sdug bsngal thams cad kyi phyir lus dang srog 'phrog pa yin te/ sman gyi sde 'di ni sdug bsngal thams cad ces bya'o/ /de nas sems can gzhon nu de dag gis bstan pa 'di thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang 'gum par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed dang sems can thams cad kyang 'chi'on / /de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar 'chi ba'i dus kyis non par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'chi ba'i dus na rnam par shes pa tha ma la —3rnam par shes pa 'gag par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rlung dang / rnam par shes pa 'khrul bar byed pa byazhes bya ba'i rlung dang / rnam par shes pa 'khrugs 5par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rlung dang /rigs kyi bu rlung gsum po 'di dag gis 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe rnam par shes pa tha ma la klong phyirabar 'gyur/ 'khrul bar 'gyur/ 'khrug 7)pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe rnam par shes pa 'gag pa na lus 'joms 8)par bgyid pa'i rlung gsum po gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag mtshon zhes bya ba dang / skul ba zhes bya ba dang / zed pa 9zhes bya bas lus 'joms nyu ripar byed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lus zhes 11bgyi ba ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag kun tu 'bar ba zhes kyang bya/ tshig pa zhes kyang bya/ ngar snabs zhes kyang bya/ sgrogs pa zhes kyang bya/ dur khrod pa zhes kyang bya/ ngan pa'i blo zhes kyang bya/ khur lci ba zhes kyang bya/ skye 48—670

bas yongs su gzir ba zhes kyang bya/ skye bas kun tu dkrugs pa zhes kyang bya/srog yongs su gdung ba zhes kyang bya/ 'chi ba dang sdug pa dang bral bar byed pa zhes kyang bya ste/ grogs po dag 'di rnams ni lus zhes 1bya'o/ /de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar 'gum/ ji ltar 'tsho/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba'o / /tshe dang ldan pa bsod nams zhes na/bya ba ni 'tsho ba'o/ /grogs po dag lus zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba ste/ rgyus pa bye bas ni dkris / spu'i khung brgyad khri bzhi stong dang ni ldan/ yan lag khri nyis stong gis ni sbrel/ rus pa sum brgya drug cus ni brtanag/ lus kyi nang na srin bu'i rigs brgyad 6)cu rtsa bzhi ni gnas te/ srog chags de dag thams cad la yang 'chi ba yang yod/ 'chi ba 'gag pa yang yod do/ /nam mi de 'chi ba de na srog chags de dag thams cad re thag chad par 'gyur te/ de na srog chags thams cad gcig la gcig za bas rlung 'khrug cing g.yo bar 'gyur te/ de na de dag sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ngo / /la la ni bu'i phyir mya ngan byed/ la la ni bu mo'i phyir mya ngan byed/la la ni gnyen gyi phyir mya ngan byed de/ de dag thams cad mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug go/ /gcig la gcig za bar brtsams nas de dag gcig gis gcig zos te srog chags gnyis shig las 7pa na de gnyis kyang zhag bdun gyi bar du 'thabs te zhag bdun 'das pa dang / srog chags gcig ni bcom mo/ /gcig ni thar to/ /tshe dang ldan pa chos zhes na bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar srog chags rnams gcig la gcig mi 'thun 9par byas nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du byis pa so so'i skye bo'i sems can rnams kyang 48—671

gcig la gcig mi 'thun 3)pa byed de/ skye bas mi 'jigs/ rga bas mi 'jigs / nad kyis mi 'jigs/ 'chi bas mi 'jigasari / ji ltar srog chags gnyis 'thab pa bzhin du byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyang phan tshun 'thab po / /de nas 'chi ba'i dus na skyes bu dge ba rnams kyis smras pa/ skyes bu khyod ci zhig la yid rton / ci khyod kyis nyes pa cung zad kyang ma mthong ngam skye ba'i nyes pa ma mthong ngam/ rga bcanadang na ba'i nyes pa ma mthong ngam 'chi ba'i nyes pa ma mthong ngam/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag gis skye ba'i nyes pa yang mthong ngo / /rga ba dang na ba'i nyes pa yang mthong ngo / /thams cad kyi tha mar 'chi ba'i nyes pa yang mthong ngo / /smras pa/ ci'i ri phyir gang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi 56)bya ba ma byas/ ci'i phyir 'jig rten gnyi gar bde ba 'phel ba'i chos kyi phung po'isngon)dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma byas/ grogs po dag gnyis su yang dri'o/ /khyod ci'i phyir0)skye ba dang / 'chi ba las yongs su thar ba'i dge ba'i tshogs ma byas/ khyod kyisam ci'i phyir tshul bzhin yid la byed pa so sor brtag pa ma byas/ ji ltar khyed 31kyis sa la gaṇ+ḍi rdung hu)ba'i sgra ma thos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing la dge ba'i sa bon bskrun 9/gecing spos sam/ phreng ba'am / mar me sbyin pa byin pa ma mthong / de bzhin gshegs pa la bza' ba dang ske/ bca' ba 'bul ba dang / 'khor bzhi tshim par byas pa yang ma mthong /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma bstan pa la mngon par dad pa de dag ni 'khor bzhi'o/ /de ltar de la phan pa'i phyir smras te/ bsnyad pa dang / lha cung zad 6kyang ma bgyis so/ /mi khyod kyis ni 'dzam bu'i gling 'du 'ongs nas mi dge ba byas so/ /de'i tshe mi shi ba de la chos 48—672

kyi ①rgyal pos rjes su bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung mthong zhing / / gaṇ+ḍi rdung du ba thosadza gyur la/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhir 'gro ba'i/ /chos bstan thos kyang ma byas so/ /de nas5༄mi des slar smras pa/ /bdag ni byis pa'i blor gyur te/ /sdig pa'i grogs kyi dbang song nas/ /'dod pas〈ge'akhrul pa'i sems kyis su/ /bdag gis sdig pa'i las byas so/ /'dod pa dag kyang bsten pa dang / /bdag gis srog chags rnams kyang (6)bsad / /dge 'dun rnams kyang chud gsan pas/ /mi bzad de yim 'bras bu 'ong ske/ /gnod par sems pa'i yid kyis su/ /bdag gis mchod rten bshigasho'u pa byas/ /tshig nganalo)rnams kyang rab tu smras/ bdag gis7) ma yang gdung bar byas/ /bdag gis nyu1lus kyis gang byas pa/ /nyes pa dag kyang rab tu shes / /sems dmyal chen po ngu 'bod du/ /shin tu mi bzad skye ba mthong / /bsdus gzhom du yang tshor ba myong / /de bzhin rab tu tsha ba dang / /mnar med chen po mi bzad par/ /tshor ba rjes su myong bar 'gyur/ /pad ma lta bur cher gas pa'i/ /sems can dmyal bar sdug bsngal du/ /thig nag btab pa 'jigs chen du/ /lan brgya bar du skye bar 'gyur/ /sems dmyal sems can bsad〈rtenas su/ /phyis kyang 'jigs pa de mthong ste/ /dpag tshad brgyar ni yang dang yang / /'jigs pa chen por ltung bar 'gyur/ /de dag sgo rnyed mi 'gyur te/ /phyis kyang mun par rab tu ltung / /spu gri zhes bya sems dmyal du/ /spu gri stong yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /byeri ba stong phrag brgya rnams kyis1lha/ /spu gri mdun du 'byung 'gyur te/ /bdag gis nyes pa'i las byas pas/ /de dag gis ni de lus gtubs/ /rlung 'khrugs chen po mi bzad pas/ /lus de 48wa 673

thams cad 'jig 1par byed/ /rtag tu 'di 'dra'ishesems dmyal du/ /bdag gis sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /lus ni rab tu sdug bsngal bar/ /sems can kun gyis bdag mthong ngo / /khyim so bya phyir gzhan dag gi/ /nor yang rab tu bdag gis blangs/ /bdag gi dzha rabu pho bu mo dang / /de bzhin phu nu sring mo dang / /bdag gi pha ma'ang de bzhin te/ /mdza' bo gnyen bshes rgyamang po dang / /bran dang las byed rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin ba dang phyugs dang g.yog /dgos pa ngan la bdag 'khrul te/ /gser dang dngul gyi snod rnams dang / /de bzhin phra rabarabagos rnams dang / /khyim byed bcug pas 'khrul nepa ste/ /khyim yang shin tu bkra byas nas/ /skyes pa bud med lang long dang ske/ /pi bang chogesil snyan 'khrol ba la/ /bdag yid ma dul dga' bar 'gyur ril/ /spos chu dag gis lus bkrus kyang / /da dung byas pa gzo ba med/ /lus khyod sems pa med pa ste/ /nga ni khyod kyi ched la 'khrul/ /phyin chad sems can 'ga' tsam yang / /bdag la skyob par 'gyur ba med/ /rlung 'khrul chen po mi bzad par/ /lus ni yongs su gdung ba na/ /ro dang ldan pa zhim zos te / /lces kyang sna tshogs de bzhin no/ /phreng ba sna tshogs bzang mdzes pa/ /rab tu mang po mgo la bcings/ /mig ni gzugs kyis 'khrul byas te/ /mig gi skyabs ni yod ma yin/ /bdag gis mthong nas gang byas pa/ /sdig pa spurnams ni mig gi rgyu/ /lag pa rdo rjes bcad pa ni/ /bdag gi rna ba'i rgyu yin rnam/ /lag pa gnyis la gdu bu btags/ /sor mo rnams la sor gdub bcug /mgul du mu tig se mo do1 / /rkang pa gnyis kyang rab tu brgyan/ /de la dra ba byas pa dang / /de la gser yang gnas par byas/ /lus la rin chen sna tshogs 48—674

dang ske/ /gsor gyi gdu bu'ang de bzhin no/ /longs spyod chen pos rab rtses nas / /yid kyang shin tu rtag 1)par gyur/ /rab tu 'jam la bdag reg nas/ /shin tu sred pas de bsten nato/ /gding ba sna tshogs mal cha yis/ /bdag gis lus ni rtser bcug gugo/ /spos chu bzang pos khrus byas te/ /spos rnamasar kyis kyang rab tu bskus(3)/ /lha rdzas ga pur tsan dan gyi/ /bdug pa rnams kyis rab tu bdugs(6)/ /kha dog bzang po byas nas kyang / /gla rtsi ldan pas rab tu bsgos/ /lo lon 'bru mar dri dag dang / /sna ma tsam pa ka la 7sogs/ /bskus nas phra mo ka shi ka /dkar po'i gos kyang rab tu bgos/ /glang po'i rgyab nas babs nas su/ / rta yi nargyab tu mngon par zhon/ /bdag ni rgyal po yin snyam sems/ /skye bo bdag gi mdun na rgyug /glu gar shin tu bslabasam9)pa yi / /slas rnams kyang ni rab tu shes/ /ri dgas rnams ni ma nyes par/ /bdag gis 3) mdas kyang ri dgas bsad11/ /'jig rten phyi ma ma shes pas/ /bdag gis 'di 'dra'i dzo/2sdig byas shing / /bdag gis gzhan gyi sha zos pas/ /de phyir bdag gi sdug bsngal 'di/ /mi bzad 'ong bar 12'gyur ba yi/ /'chi ba bdag gis ma beshes te/ /bdag ni byis pa'i blor gyur pas/ /bdag gi lus kyang gso ba byas/ /deng ni bdag la 'chi 'ong na/ /skyabs byed pa ni su yang med/ /gnyen rnams khyed cag thams cad kyang / /nga yi gdong du bltar ci yod/ /ci zhig phyir ni gos 'dral zhing / /ci phyir ngu zhing smre sngags 'don/ /ci bephyir skra rnams rab 'jig cing / /ci phyir khrag kyang 'byin par byed/ /ci phyir mgo la rdul 'thor zhing / /brang yang rab tu rdung bar byed/ /bdag gson tshe na sdig pa rnams/ /spang bar bya rigs khyed ci mdud/ /bdag gi 48wa 675

lus ni spyang ki dang / /khyi dang bya rog rnams dang ni/ /bya rnams kyis kyang bza' bar 'gyur/ /lus 'di dgos pa med par gsos/ /'chi ba'i sbrul dang ldan gyur nas/ /mi ni rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'jigs pa 'di las grol 'gyur ba/ /de lta bu yi sman rnams bsten①/ /bdag la sman pas gang byin pa'i / /sman de dgos pa ma yin na/ /nyon mongs sbrul las thar byed pa/ /da ltar chos kyi sman rnams ni/ /'chi kurasnyibadag la sbyin par byos/ /sha ni ngasal ma sbyin cig /lus 'di gso ba byas kyang ni/ /gdon mi za bar 'jig par 'gyur / /gang phyir sdug bsngal sbyin gyur pa/ /sdig gi phung po ci phyir blangs/ /lus 'di shin tu gsos byas kyang / / bya brtsobam rungs〈byed par 'gyur/ /bu dang bu mo ci zhig phyir/ /nga la mig gis lta56)bar byed/ /na ba 'di las nga skyobs shig /don med par ni ci phyir ngu / /bu dang bu mo khyed cag dag /nga rusani ma rung nyunyem byed cig /khyed cag gso bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ngas ni gzhan gyi nor yang phrogs/ /da57ni 'chi dus bab pa na/ /re thag chad kyisatsoci zhig byed/ /skye dang ngan 'gros rab tu 'jigs/ /'chi bas kyang ni yongs su gzir/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /reg pa shin tu tshor ba'o/ /sred pas byis pa rnams /tsho kyang 'khyamatso/ /mi bzad 'bras bu rnams kyang thob/ /ngan pa'i rigs su skye ba ni/ /der yang mya ngan bcings par 'gyur/ /bdag la bsod nams chung shes nas/ /skye bo gzhan dag mya ngan byed/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims yongs su nyams/ /chos la yang ni rgyab kyis phyogs/ /yang skye ba ni mi shes pas/ /nyon mongs sbrul gyis nyon mongs pa/ /ma rig 8pas ni byis pa rnams / /gang na thar pa med par 'khyamaskye/ /thar pa'i don ni mi shes nas/ /48wa 676

'khrul pas kyisdig pa rnams kyang byed/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis byis pa 'khyamanya/ /yid ni rtag tu rnam par 'khrugs/ /bcing ba sna tshogs ldan lus la ni/ /mes ni kun tu 'bar zhing tshig /gang na bde ba med pa der/ /lus ni rnam par 'khrul5gepas 'khyamanya/ /gang las shin tu bde 'byung ba/ /bde ba de ni mi shes te / /sangs rgyas zhing ni bde ba sbyin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sman gyi mchog /tshul khrims bden pa'i tshul khrims so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshangs dbyangs yin / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde sems can dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/de ltar smre sngags 'don kyang legs par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ma gtogs par de dag gi skyob par 'gyur ba su yang med do zhes bka' de skad stsal nas tshigs ⑥su bcad pa 'di dag kyang gsungs so/ /sdig pa'i las ni byas pas na/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su ltung / /sreg pa'i gos ni gyon par 'gyur/ /skom du lcags khu 'thung bar 'gyur/ /lus rnams la ni me mdag 'bab/ /tshig nas rab tu mi bzad du/ /sems can dmyal ba 'jigs chen du/ /de yi lus ni rab tu 'tshig /bde ba dag ni mi shesamadzo)shing / /chos kyang rnam par mi shes te/ /chos ma yin pas byis pa 'khyamar// /bde ba cungapo)zad rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dad dang tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /shes rab ldan zhing dka' thub che/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten 3 pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs par myur du 'gyur/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus kyi ni mchog rtsoms la/ /sems can thams cad yongs 17bzung ba//dge ba'i las kyitsha8chos ston cig /byams pa'i sems dang de bzhin du/ /48—677

tshangs spyod mchog la snyoms par zhugs/ /sman sde de skad thos nas kyang / /mchog tu bsgrub 1par 'gyur bar bya/ /rnam grol mthong dang sangs rgyas dang / /sgra bsgrags rnam 5par 'dren pa dang / /'jig rten gyi ni pha dang mcho ni/ /de ni byang chub sems zhes gi)bya/ /'jig rten du ni chos 'di gang ston pa/ /dge ba'i bshes cigeganyen mchog tu rab rnyed dka'/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gang dag sus ne nyan pa/ /de dag bla med sangs rgyas bde gshegs 'gyur/ /zhi ba sangs rgyas sras rnams la/ /gang dag gus dang bcas 'gyur ba57/ /de dag kyang ni sems can kun/ /thar byed 'jig rten mgon du 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du dog sa 'di dag52)g.yo rab tu g.yo/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi sde ci mthong ltos97/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes bltas pa dang / phyogs bzhi na sa gas pa mthong ngo / /sa gas pas sa gas pa'i phrag nas mi bye ba phrag nyi shu byung ba dang / 'og gi phyogs nas mi bye ba phrag nyi shu byung ba dang / steng gi phyogs nas mi bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ba mthong ngo de nas sems can gzhon nu de dag gis rnam par bltas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir su dag skyes/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed cag skye bo'i tshogs 'di dag la ltos/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skye bo'i tshogs 'di dag ni khyedarwa )la bde ba'i phyir skyes so/ /48—678

gsol pa/ sems can 'di dag kyang 'gum par 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag de bzhin te/ sems can thams cad kyang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sems can gzhon nu snga ma gang dag thog ma nyid du skyes pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni 17yang skye ba dang 'gum pa la bltam bar mi spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'o na brtson 'grus kyi stobs rnyed par spro'am/de dag gis gsol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du blta bar bgyi'o/ /de nas chos gang mnyan pa zhus te yid du 'ong ba mnyan par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa la blta bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba rnams la blta bar bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu la spro'i skye ba dang 'gum pa la ni blta debar mi spro'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman 37gyi sde rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya po de dag dang lhan 6cig tu stan las langs nas de dag thams cad rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi bar snang la 'gro zhing skyil mo krung 37bcas nas bsam gtan byed de/ de dag thams cad kyi lus las seng ge rnams byung ngo / /stag rnams byung ngo / /sbrul rnams byung ngo / /glang po rnams byung ngo //rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam par 'phrul pa ston to/ /ri la yang skyil mo krung 8bcas te 'khod do/ /steng du dpag tshad nyi khri srid du yang 9'gro'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma bye ba stong phrag bcu yang 'bab par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la sems can gzhon nu de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od 48—679

zer chen po gda' ba dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam par 'phrul ba 'jig rten du byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu khyed zla ba dang / nyi ma byung ba 'di la ltos/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' tu)rang gi lus las 'od zer snang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul bstan ②pa ste bstan nas kyang skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang /lha rnams dang / mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir sems can rnams la chos ston te/ de dag 'dir mi'i lus dang / stobs dang brtson 'grus bstan nas 'di 'dra ba'i stobs nye (babar ston to/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'od zer snang ba 'byung bar bgyi ba'i slad du chos bstan du gsol / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi sde khyod kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /des 'di snyam bsams te④/ gang bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la don de zhu'o/ /snyam bsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang /ngas〈dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /bstan par bya'o/ /rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /sman gyi sde gang 'das pa dang /48wa 680

ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus rnams kyi de thams cad bstan par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das the tsomanyebasal ba'i slad du bstan du gsol / bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i bu stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang / klu'i rgyal po bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba dang / 'byung po bye ba stong phrag bco labargyad kyis bskor ba dang /yi dgas dang / sha za bye ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lngas bskor ba mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde sems can 'di dag ni chos nyan ②pa'i phyir 'khor 'dir nga'i gan du 'dus shing 'khod gor ma chag ste/sman gyi sde 'di dag ni deng kho nar 'khor bshogebasnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cadapo)la phan parapo 'dod pas deng nyid sa bcu rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcu la rab tu gnas nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings rjes su 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /rga dang 'chi las thar bya'i phyir/ /las byas bde ba thob byed cing / /nyon mongs zhags pa pham byas nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'thob par 'gyur④/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi gnas mang po las sna tshogs kyis byung bshe'adi ci'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor cing gnas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde nyon cig /sems 0can rmongs pa mi shes pa/ /thar bar 'gyur ba ga la yod/ /sems can gzhon nu mang po dag /de ring gzugs rnams thobatshwa )par 'gyur/ /sa bcu dag ni 'thob pa'i phyir/ /chos kun rab tu shes par 'gyur/ /sa bcu dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bya ba byed par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 48—681

'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /chos char rab tu 'bebs par 'gyur/ /de ltar sems can 'dus pas na/ /nga yi bstan pa 3)dga' ba'o/ /lha dang klu dang yi dgas dang / /lha min shin tu mi bzad pas(5/ /sa bcu la ni rab gnas te/ /chos kyi sgra 3yang sgrogasar par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rnga yang rdung riribar 'gyur/ /chos kyi dung yang rab tu 'bud/ /sems can gzhon nu 'di dag kyang / /brtson 'grus mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pas thob sne)pa bzhin / /de dag deng ni chos thobar 'gyur/ /de nas sems can gzhon nu lnga stong tsam stan las langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang phyir mtha' ni ma 'tshal ba/ /'khor ba na ni 'chi ba ste/ /lus ni khur lci bcom ldan 'das/ /'jigs pa chen po mi bzad pa/ /lam ni rnam par ma 'tshal te//lam nyid kyang ni mi gda' bas/ /mgon po bdag cag ldongs gyur na/ /bdag cag rnams ni bsdu bar gsol/ /dpa' la bdag cag gsol ba 'tshal/ /'dren pas chos ni bshad du gsol/ /bdag cag shes rab chung lde)ngur skyes/ /bde ba mngon par ma 'tshal to/ /bdag cag la ni chos bshad gsol/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad grol bar mdzod/ /gang dang gang du skyes par yang / /bdag cag sangs rgyas mthong gyur cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde sems can gzhon nu rnams ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed cag rnams ni zas zo shig /rmad59)du byung ba'i ro yang 'thung nyu bye/ /'jigs pa med par gyur nas su/ /phyis gdod 37'jigs med chos nyon cig /smras pa/ btsun pa gnas brtan khyod su zhig /bdag 48wa 682

cag rnams kyis khyod mi shes/ /khyod ni rab tu mdzes par mthong / /gzugs ni zhi zhing grags pa che/ /yi dgas 'jig rten 'jigs chen dang / /sems dmyal dud 'gro rnams las thar/ /ji ltar 'gro ba mdzes pa bzhin/ /khyod kyi sdig pa thams cad zhi/ /khyod kyi lag na snod yod pa/ /rin chen sna bdun ldan pa dang / /lus la rin chen srad bu dang / /gzi brjid phung pos brgyan pa mthong ske/ /zhi ba khyod kyis tshig smras pa/ /bdag cag lan 'debs mi nus so/ /bdag cag la ni zas rnams dang / /zhim po'i skom yang mi dgos te/ /zas las bshang ba 'byung bar 3)'gyur/ /de bzhin skom yang gcin du 'gyur/ /khu ba rnams las khrag tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin khrag las shar 'gyur bas/ /zas dang skom rab sbyar ba yang / /bdag cag rnams la dgos ma yin/ /dar dang snam bu sbyar ba dang / /phra mo'i tsho gos kyang dgos pa med/ /gser gyi gdu bu mi dgos te/ /mu tig phreng ba dgos ma yin/ /sor gdub dag kyang mi dgos te//de kun mi rtag chos can no/ /bdag cag ngan par 'gro rnams su/ /'gro bar mi 'gyur srog tshol 0lo/ /lha rnams kyi ni bde ba dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa don du gnyer/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dgos te/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal ma yin no/ /rab tu bzang ba'i gling bor nas/ /'khor los sgyur ba 'chi bar 'gyur / /bu yang phyi bzhin mi 'brang ste/ /chung ma bu mo rnams kyang min/ /rin chen sna bdun phyi na las ri/ /phyi bzhin 'brang ba ma yin no/ /skye bo mang po bsdus pa yang / /phyi bzhin 'gro ba ma yin te/ /mdun du rgyug pa'ang ma yin no / /de ltar phyin cad 5mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe gcig gis 6tshoni rgyal po las/ /mi rtagatso)pas ni 'khyam rina'agyur te/ /sdig pa'i las rnams mang byas pas/ de 48—683

dag sems dmyal ngu 'bod lhung / /rin chen sna bdun rdzu 'phrul ches/ /phyogs bzhi kun tu bskor ba las/ /gang tshe ngu 'bod smin pa'i tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul de ni gang du song / /sa gang dag na yod min pa/ /shi nas rdzu 'phrul byed mi nus / /gnas brtan bdag cag rnams la gson/ /gang na de bzhin gshegs par bzhud/ /pha dang ma ni ji lta bar/ /de ni mthong bar rab tu 'dod/ /bdag cag la ni ma yang med/ /pha med phu nu rnams kyang med/ /'jig rten gtso bo de bzhin gshegs/ /de nyid pha dang ma yin no/ /de nyid7nyi ma zla ba ste / /bde ba'i lam ni rab ston pa'o/ /gang phyir phyin chad mi skye bar/ /de ni 'khor ba thar mdzad pa'o/ /nyon mongs chu bo ri 'jigs chen dang / /chu bo sgrol ba'i gru de'o/ /de yis sems can rab bsgral te/ /phyin chad slar ni mi ldog go/ /byang chub mchog ni rab ston pa/ /dam pa'i chos kyang des bshad do//bdag cag rnams la zas mi dgos/ /rgyal srid 'bras bu mi 'dod de/ /sems can dmyal bas 'jigs pa ni/ /lha yi 'jigate༄5)rten 'gro mi bya/ /mi yi tshe ni bde ba ste/ /de na thams cad mkhyen par snang / /rang gi las ni nyes byas pas/ /tshe thung rnams ni 'khyam tshanapa yin/ /de dag 'chi ba mi shes kyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod rgyal srid shes/ /skye dang 'gag pas bslus pa rnams/ /shes pa med cing 'jigs pa med/ /mi rtag 5pas ni sems 'khrul rnams/ /phra ba'i chos rnams mi shes te/ /phra ba'i dgos pa mi byed la/ /zhi ba'i dbyings kyang mi shes so/ /'chi 'pho la ni skyo med pa/ /yang dang yang du skye bar 'gyur/ /yun ring sdug bsngal rab gzir cing / /rtag tu dbyug pasakhebardegs byas nas / /gzhan dag gi yang 'phrog byed de/ /de bzhin bcing zhing bsad pa 48wa 684
