byas / /sngon gyi sdig pas bskul bas na/ /de dag bcing ba lngas bcings so/ /re thag kyang ni chad par 'gyur/ /mya ngan zug rngus zug par 'gyur/ /rnam par shes pa 'gag pa na/ /snying rje bar ni smre sngags 'don/ /bdag gi skyob par su 'gyur la/ /gser dang dngul dang shel dag dang / /longs spyod thams cad bdag gis dbul/ /bdag ni bran du'ang 'gyur bar bya/ /bran gyi tshul du gang77gyur pa/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu bya/ /rgyal srid longs spyod bdag mi dgos/ /nor dang 'bru yang ma yin no/ /rang gi lus ni bdag mi dgos/ /sdig pa byed pa mi 'grol te/ /de ltar gnas brtan bdag cag la//bza' ba dgos pa ma yin no/ /gang dag kha zas zhim zos pa/ /rgyal po rnams kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /btung ba mchog ni 'thungs pa yi/ / lha yisabu rnamasalge'achi bar 'gyur/ /cho ma cho dgu ro ldan pa/ /zas dang skom ni rab bshams te / /chol po'i mdun du blangs nas su/ /kha zas la ni lces reg nas/ /rgyal po rnams ni ro la chags/ /sdig pa mi chung rnams kyang byed/ /gang la snying po med pa yi/ /mi rtag ro la chags par byed/ /bdag cag rnams la skom mi dgos / /bza' ba dag kyang dgos ma yin/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal gang grol ba / /chos nyid de 'dra dgos ma yin/ /sred pa'i bcings las rab grol zhing //sred pa'i nyon mongs rnams54)thar te/ /bcings pa kun las rab grol ba'i/ /sangs rgyas de la skyabs su dong / /drang srong chen po 'jig 55)mgon la/ /bdag cag rnams ni skyabs su 'dong / /sems can rnams kyis mthong dka' la / /phyag 'tshal yiphyir ni bdag cag 'dong / /khyod kyi mtshan ni ma 'tshal gyis / /snyan tshepa'i mtshan ni bstan du gsol/ /sman gyi sdes smras pa/ khyedapo 48—685

dang skye bo thams cad dang / /de bzhin ming ni thos par 'dod/ /sems can gzhon nu bye ba phrag /stong gis de bzhin gshegs pa bskor/ /sde dag gis smras pa/ khyod ni sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi༅ci/ /ming ni zab nadapar grags pa yin//skye bo kun kyang de bzhin du/ /khyod kyi ming ni thos par 'dod/ /smras pa/ nga yi riming ni sman gyi sde/ /nga ni sems can rnams kyi sman/ /sman rnams kun gyi dam pa ni/ /khyed cag rnams la bshad par bya/ /nad kun gyis btab skye bo yi / /nad rnams thams cad zhi bar byed/ /'dod chags nad ni nad po che/ /'jig rten 'jigs ca)byed mi bzad pa/ /gang gis blo med 'khyamasapa yi/ /gti mug nad ni che zhing drag /sems dmyal de bzhin dud 'gro dang / /yi dgas rnams su sems can 'gro/ /byis pa 'di dag zhe sdang zin/ /de dag ji ltar zhi bar 'gyur/ /de dag gis smras pa/ dge ba'i chos ni 'di thos pas/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /byis pa blo ni mi shes pa/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol nas kyang / /sdig pa'i las ni rnam ne spangs te/ /bdag cag chos kyi sbyin pa nyan/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /'jigs pa mi bzad rnams kyang spangs/ /nad rnams thams cad zhi byed pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po sman pa ste/ /sdug bsngal ba rnams gso byed pa/ /yang dag sangs rgyas myur du blta/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag bya phyir/ /gnas brtan khyod ri ni myur du bzhud / /phyag byas bdag cag rnams kyi tshig /'jig rten rnam par 'dren la gsungs / /nad 'di rab tu zhi bar mdzod/ /lus ni thams cad rab 'bar te / /tshig cing zhi ba med pa yi/ /mi bzad me ni zhi bar mdzod/ /lus kyi khur ni khur po che/ /shin tu mi bzad rno ba'i khur/ /sdug bsngal gzir ba 48wa 686

bdag cag la/ /brtul zhugs dam pa thugs rje mdzod/ /skye bo rtag tu zhes1snang dang / /gti mug non pa'i khur khyer te/ /khur las thar ba mi shes pa/ /de dag yang dang yang khur khyer/ /thar pa'i lam ni mi shes shing / /thar pa'i lam ni ma mthong rnams/ /'chi ba rnam par shes med kyi/ /'on kyang 'jigs pa mi skyed do/ /bdag cag la ni nam du yang / /'chi ba med snyam bde bar gnas / /kun tu 'khrul pas mar shi ba/ /mthong yang rnam par mi shes so/ /de dag pha yang mi dran te/ /nad kyis kyang ni rtag gzir cing / /nyon mongs las kyis rab dkrugasang na/ /ji ltar kha gizas za bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal nyam7thag mi shes te/ /bdag cag ngal ba don med do/ /khyod57kyi sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba/ /ma rig gzhi las skyes pa'o/ /'dung shes 'du byed tshor ba rnams / /'jigs chen lci ba'i khur yin no/ /gang chos rnam par she)mi shes pa/ /byis pa sred pas rab tu 'khyama'o)/ /lus kyi khur gyis bskor ba ni/ /'jig rten du ni don med skyes/ /gos gtsang shin tu bzang ba dang / /khrus dang byug pa dgos pa'o/ /lus la gang yid bo'ong ba yi/k+ko/ /kha zas zhim po dgos pa ste//yid 'ong ba yi 1 sil snyan lnga1nye/ /de bzhin rna bas tshor bar byed/ /rin chen bdun las byung ba yi/ /gzugs la mig gis chags par byed/ /zhim pa'i ro rnams thams cad ni/ /lces kyang tshor bar byed pa ste/ /'jam zhing phra ba'i reg pa yang / /lus kyis rtag tu tshor bar byed/ /lus kyis su ni sha gnyis po/ /dga' bar yang ni bsgrubs pa las/ /sems pa med pa'i lus 'di skyes/ /de la dga' ba su zhig rnyed/ /de na cibadag rkang dga' byed pa/ /lham ni rab tu bzang gyon yang / /'chi bar 'gyur tshe gos rnams dang / /byug pa skyabs su mi 48—687

'gyur te/ /lus kyang skyabs su 'gyur min nanya)/ /gos dang byug pa smos ci dgos / /mi zhes bya ba lus yin te/ /dbugs dang stobs chen rnyed par51)'gyur / /so sor rtog rinapa'i rnam )ba'i stobs/ /de ni lus la yon tan che/ /sngon chad rta dang glang po yis(ge/ /kun tu bskor nas rtse zhing 'khyamanye/ /thar pa'i chos ni ma shes nas47/ /bdag ci sdig pa'i las la chags/ /'jig rten pha rol ma shes nas/ /rtse bas sdig pa byed du bcug /bdag ni yang dang yang skyes te/ /shi ba bdag la yang 'ongs so/ /yang dang yang du mya ngan mthong / /smre sngags 'don pas rab tu bcings/ /ma rnams kyang ni shi ba mthong pha rnams shi dang gnyen dag dang / /sring mo dang ni bu dag dang / /chung ma rnams kyang shi ba mthong / /mngon par 'du byed kun stong na/ /sems dang bcas pa su zhig chags/ /'dod pas zin pa'i sems kyis su/ /bdag gis yid brtan rung bar shes/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mi dmigs te/ / 'chi bsnyel ni mngon dga' med/ /de phyir 'dod pas bsgribs sems kyis/ /bdag gis sbyin pa ma byin no/ /de bas 'dod dang mnyam sdig med/ /de ni da dung mi ldog go/ /kun tu nor bas bdag cag skyes/ /'gro ba mtha' dag kun tu nor//kun tu nor ba'i sgra yang nyan/ /dam chos ma yin yongs su 'dzin/ /thar pa dang ni bsam gtan btsal/ /lus ni khur 9)du bkur mi bya/ /'jig rten don du 'gro ba'i gtso/ /sangs rgyas ston pa rnams su shog /sangs rgyas 'jig rten pha dang ma/ /sangs rgyas lam ni rab ston pa/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni kun tu yang ske/ /rin chen char pa rab tu 'bebasabo/ /chos kyi bsdu ba ci 'dra ba/ /sems can blun pos mi shes te/ /byang chub tu ni sems bsngos na/ /chos kyi 48wa 688

bsdu ba thob par 'gyur/ /'du byed thams cad stong pa ste/ /de bzhin longs spyod nor yang stong / /bdag kyang stong par mthong bas na/ /mthong nas re ba med par gyur6)/ /gnas brtan sman gyi sde khyod kyis/ /bdag cag rnams kyi tshig gson cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir/ /khyod ni pho nyar bzhud 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams dran nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyo ba med/ /brtson 'grus ldan zhing dka' thub che/ /yon tan kun tu sdud par byed/ /ston de ga la bzhugs par bzhud/ /ston pa bde bar rab sad nas/ /rgyal ba cung zad mi skyo bar/ /bdag cag slad du zhu ba mdzod/ /khyod kyis bdud ni gzhom pa dang / stobs dang bcas pa pham par byas/ /sems can thams cad yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /chos kyang myur du 'bar bar byas/ /gang7gis sangs rgyas 'gyur ba yiri —/ /chos ni bdag cag ma thos kyis9)/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /gnas brtan myur du bzhud du gsol/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma mthong ba/ de srid bdag cag mi rgal zhes/ /thams cad gus dang bcas par gnas/ /sman gyi sdes smras pa/ khyed cag depo)ltar ci zhig mthong / /re zhig gyen du blta bar byos / /de dag gyen du bltas pa dang / /khang pa brtsegs pa sum stong dang / /lnga brgya tham par tshang ba zhig /kun tu yang ni gnas par gyur/ /rin chen bdun gyis shin tu spras/ /rin chen dra bas legs par brgyan/ /dbus na me tog rab tu rgyasañca / /lha rdzas spos kyang rab tu 'bab/ /de na gnas brtan dris pa ni/ /khang brtsegs rin chen dra ba dang / /pad ma ze bar kun gnas par / /'di na snang ba 'di ci zhig /sman gyi sdes smras pa/ gnas 'di dag 48wa 689

ni khyed kyi ste/ /sangs rgyas blta ba'i phyir deng 3)shig /'jig rten 'das gtso gang yin pa/ /'jig rten snang byed de la thud / /de dag gis smras pa/ de yi lam yang ma 'tshal te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang ma mthong na/ /gang na lam yang ma 'tshal bas/ /phyag 'tshal du ni gang du mchi/ /sman gyi sdes smras pa/nam mkha' mtha' yas ji bzhin du/ /reg ri par rung ba ma yin pas/ /bdud rtsi rab sbyin ston pa la/ /phyag 'tshal phyir ni 'gro mi nus/ /ji ltar ri rab gnas pa ltar/ /ston pa de yang gnas na bzhugs/ /ri rab gzhal du rung ba yin / /rgya mtsho chen po gting tshod zin/ /stong gsum rdul phran dpag tu rung //sangs rgyas 'byung ba shes ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu nas/ /'jig rten snang bar mdzad la 'dud/ /smras pa/ 'jig rten mgon po bdag cag gzigs/ /bdag cag bsam pa rdzogs par mdzod/ /bdag cag sems kyis ston pa la/ /phyag bgyis de nas 'bras bu thob/ /sman gyi sdes smras pa/ston pa dri la mi chags te/ /phreng ba ma yin byug pa min/ /gang gis 'dus byas grol 'gyur ba/ /sems can rnams kyi rgyu 'dzin to/ /gang gis yid ni btul byas shing / /sangs rgyas la yang skyabs song ba/ /de la bdud ni mi bzad mchog /thab 44)mo rgol bar mi byed do/ /'chi ba'i dbang du mi 'gro yi/ /gzungs ni myur du rnyed par 'gyur/ /de sems rab tu dang byas nas/ /de nas ston pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ka la ping ma'i sgra skad yid du 'ong ba 'dzum 5pa mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde stan las langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di 48wa 690

skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer brgyad khri bzhi stong byung ste/ 'od zer de dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khyab par gyur / sems can dmyal ba chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad kyang khyab par gyur/ lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang snang bar gyur/ 'od zer de dag kyang kha dog sna tshogs sha stag la 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po dang le brgan dang shel dang dngul gyi kha dog lta bu ste/ 'od zer de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas byung nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams la bde bar sbyar ba thams cad bgyis nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun bskor ba bgyis nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug 17tu nub par gyur pa'i 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags(2/ rkyen gang lags/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag la skabs dbye bar gnang na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi sde khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / ngas dris 9 pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi la sems rangs par bya'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das sems can gzhon nu bye ba stong phrag sum cu byung ba de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos phra ba bstan pa rtogs nas/ sems can rgan po 48—691

rnams la sems can rgan po khyed rnams ni chos mi shes pa'o/ /rtag tu chos ma yin pa dang / mi dge ba la chags pa'o/ /zhes phra mo rnams mi snyan pa mchi zhing yongs su rjod ti la gnod pa bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du tshig snyan pa yid du 'ong ba 'di dag smras/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / sman gyi sde de dag ci'i phyir tshig 'di skad smra bas mi shes sam/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jam zhing shin tu snyanaragyipa smra ste/ chos kyang thos pas sman gyi sde de'i phyir de dag chos thams cad kyi don khong du chud par 'gyur/yon tan thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur/ de dag thams cad gzungs rtogs par 'gyur/ deng phyin chad sa bcu la gnas par 'gyur/ deng chos kyi rnga chen po'i sgra 'byin par 'gyur/ deng chos chen po'i rnam pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dag mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde deng nyid sems can gzhon nu 'di dag khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dag gi nang du zhugs nas chos mngon par rtogs pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /deng nyid dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /deng chos kyi rnga chen po rdung bar 'gyur te/ lha'i ris du ma zhig deng chos mngon par rtogs pa thob par byed par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba pa'i ri sems can log par ltung dugeb la gnas pa mang po dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bstan57pa thos nas 'khor ba bsnyil te rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe sems can rgan po bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu thams cad kyis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'thob /ste/ de dag thams cad kyang chos dang ldan 48—692

par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde de dag thams cad ni sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su spangs par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde de dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde de dag thams cad ni chos chen po'i sgra dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde phyogs bzhir ltos shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 7phyogs bzhi kun tu bltas pa dang /shar phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed 'ong / lho phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag drug cu'i bye ma snyed 'ong / nub phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag bdun cu'i bye ma snyed 'ong / byang phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgyad cu'i bye ma snyed 'ong / 'og gi phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag dgu bcu'i bye ma snyed 'ong / steng gi phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma snyed 'ong ste / de dag lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sdes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' bar snang la gzugs nag po dang / gzugs dmar po gda' ba cisalags/ bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde gang bar snang la gzugs nag po dang ske/ gzugs dmar po mthong ba 'di ci yin mi shes sam/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni mkhyen te/ sman gyi sde 'di ni bdud yin no/ /sman gyi sde mthong bar 'dod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde byang 48—693

chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma dang mnyam pa 'di lta bu lhags so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag lhags pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi sde sems can gzhon nu rnams kyi rkyen gyis te/ de sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi sde khyod kyis sems can gzugs sna tshogs 'dir lhags pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis nya)byin gyi rlabs sna tshogs 'di 2)lhags pa dag mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bdag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma snyed dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bye ma snyed cig rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus gnas te/ gzugs sna tshogs kha dog sna tshogs dbyibs sna tshogs pa dag gnas la/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'phags pa'i chos kyi gnas la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'khor dang bcas nas chos kyi gnas la gnas pa mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpa' ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' gsar rnying ri nide dag kun dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang ske/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do//'phags pa zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs rdzogs sor// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi 6non mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu 7richen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban de 8ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad 9kyis kyang 48wa 694

༄ga /'phags pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/① ༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā btsin chosat+ya pra bhābs nir de sho nākem dharma 46)par+sā ༅ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags ④pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa7dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun huXdaga' ra ba na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya tsam dang /thabs cig hu tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por gnas nas bzhugs te/ rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / grong rdal gyi mi dang / nang mi rnams kyis bstikhestang du byas/ btsun par byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa7byas te/ bcom 48—708

ldan 'das kyis bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / phyog tu)pa dang / myang7ba bzang po mang7po brnyes so/ /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas riga'agapa dang zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ gdung phun sum tshogs pa/ cho rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa/ ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa/ rnam par grol ba phun sum tshogs pa/rnam par grol ba'i cir ye shes gzigs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o zhes/ bcom ldan 'das kyi grags pa'i sgra dang / snyan pa 'jig rten du rgya cher mngon du byung bar gyur to/ /bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyang ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byangasang ba/yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /spyan lnga dang yang 7ldan te/ sha'i spyan dang /lha'i spyan dang / chos kyi spyan dang / shes rab kyi spyan dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang ldan no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan mu stegs can spyod 33pa pa dang ske/ kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa tshotshoganyen gyi bu 〉rnams ni tshar bcad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di lha dang mi rnams kyis yang dag par bzung zhing 'bar ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus kyi tshe chos gos dang sham 48—709

thabs mnabs 1te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ mdun du gzigs pa dang / g.yas g.yon du gzigs pa mdzes (2pa dang / bskum pa dang / brkyang ba mdzes pa dang ske/ chos gos snam sbyar dang / bsil zan dang / na bza'i tshags du dang /lhung bzed bsnams pa mdzes pa dang / sku mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang /'od 'dom gang bas mtshan mo mun pa mun nag gi nang na me'i phung po lta bu dang /tshes bco na)lnga'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang / nyi ma shar ba lta bur phyogs su snang zhing skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cusartsamachogaganyis dang ni 7ldan te/ grong khyer chen por lde)mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir gshegs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag ma thag tu/ de nas mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por grong khyer du gshegs pa na/ cho 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba chos rnam pa 'di dag byung ste/ skyes bu dam pa 'dren pa de gshegs pa'i tshe/ der cho 'phrul rmad du byung ba chen po gang dag byung ba de dag brjod par bya te)/ shin tu dad pa'i 1 )sems kyis nyon cig /long ba rnams kyis 31 ni mthong ngo 'on pa rnams kyis ni thos so/ /gcer bu rnams kyis ni gos rnyed do/ /smyon pa rnams kyis ni /2dran hu pa thob po/ /grong khyer gyi skye bo thams cad ni thal mo sbyar te / bde bar gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnga bo che dang rdza rnga dang khar tsharnga dang ske/ sgra snyan dag ni ma brdungs par sgra 'byung ngo / /ngang pa dang / ngur pa dang ske/ khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / khu byug dag kyang yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin to/ /gang dag gter stor ba de dag gis ni gter rnams 48wa 710

rnyed par gyur to/ /gser dang dngul las byas pa'i snod rnams kyang ma dkrolam tubar sgra byung ngo / / sa yanga'adirnam pa drug tu g.yos shing 'gul te/ sems can rnams skyabs med par yang ma gyur cig ri /yid dang ba rab tu thob bo/ /smra ba'i mchog dam pa sangs rgyas kyis gang dang gang du zhabs kyis gom pa bor ba de dang der pad ma dri ma med cing / legs par gnas pa rnams byung ngo / /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i sems can gang dag gis mthong ba de dag thams cad kyang bde ba rnyed nas mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med gang dag sbrum pa de dag kyang mi bde ba med pa nyid du gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pa dag btsas so/ /sems can rnams la yang 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gtisamug rnams kyis gnod par gyur pa med do/ /rab tu snang56)ba'i sems med par phan tshun du 7 smra ste/ dper na pha'am ma zhig bu gcig na pa la smra ba bzhin no/ /srang gi g.yas g.yon rnams kyang legs par brgyan par gyur to/ /nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis kyang me tog sil ma dag mngon par gtor to/ /sems can 9 sdug bsngal bar gyur pa gang yang med nyi 7do//sems can gang dag na bar gyur pa de dag kyang nad med par gyur 31te/ bde ba thob bo/ /bde bar gshegs pa gshegs pa na sems can so so nas de bzhin gshegs pa ci hu bdag kho 12na la gzigs so snyam du sems so/ /so so nas bdag nyid bsod snyoms sa'abul zhing / mi'i 'dren pa la brten nas bdag kho na bsod snyoms kyi 'bras bu la sbyor ro snyam du sems te/ de gshegs pa tsam yang gzhal bar sla ba bem yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du mthar chags su bsod snyoms bzhes shing gshegs nas/ bcom 48—711

ldan 'das grong bar gyi dbus zhiganyetu gshegs pa dang / de'i tshe khang stong zhig tu khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta5nyan sdug pa zhig bor bar gyur te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub ri mo khar bcug nas/ 'jib cing 'dug pa la khyi'am sna/ ce55)spyang gang dag khang stong der lhags pa de dag kyang khye'u de la lce'i dbang pos bldags shing 'dong7ste/ ji ri7)ltar sngon byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas khye'u de la 'tshe ba mi byed do/ /khang stong der skye bo phal po che dag kyang 'jug cing 'byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che 'jug cing 'byung ba gzigs nas mkhyen bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang du skye bo phal po che 'di dag 'jug cing 'byung ba'i khang stong de na ci yod ltos/ de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi57ltar mnyan te/ khang stong ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta7na sdug pa zhig lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzubasgo7mo khar bcug ste/ 'jib cing 'dug la mig gnyis mi 'dzums77par skye bo'i tshogs thams cad la lta ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la skabs de gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khang stong de na khye'u bor ba gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta (nyen sdug pa/rin po che'i gzugs ltar mchis pa/ mig mi 'dzums hunyepar skye bo'i tshogs thams cad la lta ba zhig mchis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kye ma khye'u 'di ni sngon gyi sbyor kheb phun sum tshogs pa ste/ nga'i legs par bshad pa'i don shes par nus shing / skal ba locan no snyam nas/ khye'u de la thugs brtse 48—712

ba dang / skye bo phal po che dge ba la gzud pa'i phyir 1)/ khang stong ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das der gshegs nas phyogs gcig tu bzhugs te/ phyogs gcigashogatu bzhugs nas/ khye'u de la tshigs su bcad de snobaka' stsal pa/ sbrul dang gnod sbyin rgyu ba yib/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa che 'di na / /byis pa ji ltar mi 'jigs shing / /khyod dacigacig pu 'di na 'dug /de nas khye'u des sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / rang gi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas/bcom ldan 'das la slar tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ bdag ma mchis pa'i tshogs7rnams la/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug su zhig 'jigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa smra ba'i mchog /ji ltar 'dir mchis las gang lags/ /bdag gcig bdag gis5nyagang ma mchis/ /bdag kyang gang gi'ang 3)ma lags te/ /bdag ni bu'i lags de ma mthong / /bdag gi su lags de ma mthong / /bcom ldan 'das ༷kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sngon cad 37 sdig pa byas pa'i las/ /de yi rnam smin 'di 'dra ste/ /khang pa stong pa 'dir bor nas/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong ba yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/ gi tam khang stong snyam pa 431/ /'du shes da dung mnga' ba blta/ /byang chub snying por khyod bzhugs nas/ /'du shes yongs su ma mkhyen tam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ngas ni 'du shes yongs shes te/ /nga la 'du shes yod ma yin/ /khyod nyid la 32ni snying brtse bas//khang pa hunyestong pa 'dir 'ongs so/ /khye'us gsol pa/ sems can dag ni bar 'ga' yang / /gang tshe shin tu mi dmigs pa/ /de tshe thugs rje gang du byung / /khyod ni su la thugs brtse mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bdag med zhi ba stong pa nyid/ /sems can 'di dag mi shes te/ /de dag nyid 48—713

la snying brtse'i 51 phyir/ /bsod nams spyad pa spyod pa yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/stong pa zhi bar nathugs chud nas/ /zhi ba stong pa nyid mkhyen kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa da dung du/ /phyin ci log kyang ma spangs risam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /zhi ba stong pa nyid rtogs nas/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i 4 phyir/ /'dren pa chos ston mdzad pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa da dung du/ /khyod kyis phyin ci log ma spangs/ /sems can 'du shes ma mchis na/ /thugs rje gang du skye bar 'gyur/ /55ribacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byang chub sems ni rab bzung nas/ /yod min sems can rnams la yang mi mchog rnams ni go gyon pa/ /rang byung rnams kyis 67byin rlabasamatso)so/ /khye'us gsol pa / dngos po gang na'ang na/mi dmigs pas/ /go cha thams cad brdzunamatho)pa lags / /dngos po ma mchis chos rnams la/ /go cha dmigs pa mtshwa )mchis so /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /chos rnams dngos po yod min yang / /srog chags rnams la chos ston 'di/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob 31rnams kyi/ /thugs rjes rnam par rol pa yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/ chos ni yi ge ma mchis na / /bshad pa gud na ga la mchis/ /'jig rten rnams la slu mdzad dmathe / /chos ma lags pa chos bshad dam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nga ni 'jig rten slu ma yin/ /chos ma yin pa'ang 1geng mi smra/ /phyin ci log gyur sems can gyi/ /nyon mongs sel bar nga byed do/ /khye'us gsol pa/ nyon mongs rtsa ba ma mchis te/ /nang ngam phyi rol rnams na yang / /de dag rnams kyi gnas ma mchis/ /nyon mongs ji ltar rnam par sbyang / /bcom ldan 'das 48—714

kyis0)bka' stsal pa/ /phyin ci log las byung ba rnams/ /yongs su brtags las skyes pa ste/ /rtogs pa thams cad spang ba'i phyir/ /srog chags rnams la chos ston bto/ /khye'us gsol pa/ rnam brtag mang po ci 'tshal te/ /sems ni rang〈4)bzhin 'od gsal zhing / /de la nyon mongs mi 'byung ste/ / nams kyangasanyon mongs de mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ji skad smras pa 94de bzhin te/ /sems niston/rtag tu 'od gsal kyang / /blolo bur nye ba'i nyon mongs kyis/ /so so'i skye bo nyon mongs 'gyur/ /khye'us gsol pa/nyon mongs dmigs su ma mchis te/ /de dag phyogs na mi gnas na/ /blomanyu)bur du ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /de zhus bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dper na sprin rnams bar snang la/ /snang yang de dag de bzhin min/ /nyon mongs 'byung ba'ang de 'dra ste/ /snang yang de dag de bzhin min/ /khye'us gsol pa/ ma nor de bzhin gang lags pa/ /chos gnas nyid de chos nyid do/ /ma nor de bzhin nyid chos la/ /nor ba'i de bzhin nyid mi dmigs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byis pa 'du shes ldan rnams kyis/ / /log par rnam par gang brtags pa/ /blo de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams 'byung ba yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/skye ma mchis pas rab phye ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang zhig byung / /skye ba ma mchis chos rnams la/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'thad nyanyam lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /skye ba 12med par skye ba ni/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab tu bstan/ /kun rdzob tha snyad lha btags pa ste/ /dam pa'i don du yod ma yin/ /khye'us gsol pa/ da dung khyod la don dam dang / /kun 48—715

rdzob 'du shes gnyis mnga' ste/ /theg pa gcig lam 'gal 'gyur ba/ /gi tam khyod kyis bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nga7ni lam dang 'gal mi byed/ /'gal ba med par ngasheganas te/ /mi 'thun⑧sems can sdums kyang byed/ /khye'u khyod de ltar shes par gyis/ /khye'us gsol pa / sems can de ni mi dmigs na/ /gi ta ma khyoda'aji ci sdums mdzad/ /chos rnams sngon gyi mtha' la gzigs/ /gang gidza kun nas nyon mongs skye/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang / /de bzhin da ltar byung ba dang / /byang chub dam pa rtogs gyur nas/ /srog chags rnams la chos ston to/ /khye'us gsol pa/ rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes sgrogs7mdzad cing / /nyid kyi tshimakhyen pa sgrogs 2)mdzad de/ /'di ltar bdag tu sgro 'dogs pas/ /khyod ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal che/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nga7ni bdag la mi stod7de/ /de bzhin gzhanatshwanyel brnyas〈nyemi byed//de bzhin nyid ni rab tu ston/ /des na de bzhin gshegs zhesatsobya/ /khye'us gsol pa/ brjod du ma mchis de bzhin nyid/ /de na de nyid ma mchis na/ /sgra skad ma mchis sgra bshad pa/ /mkhyen bzhin log par bka' ma stsal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /chos de thams cad log pasaste/ /de bzhin nyid las byung ba yin/ /de bzhin nyid ni rtogs pas na/ /nga7la skyon med yon tan med/ /khye'us gsol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu yinasan/ /bdag gi spobs pa 'di skyes te/ /'di 'dra'i lan dag gang gsol pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la bzod par gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can chos gos kyi nang nas phyungatshwa 7ste/ khye'u de'i hurte48wa 716

logs su brkyang ba dang / de nas khye'u des bcom ldan 'das kyi0phyag gi sor mo la bzung ste langasasheso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u de khang stong nas bsnams te/ srang du bzhag pa dang / de na skye bo phal po che dag 'di ltar khye'u 'di 'di kho na ltar nyon mongs par gyur kyang / bdag nyid chen po'i chos 'di lta bu'i lan⑧'debs pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ngo mtshar to snyam nas/ ngo mtshar du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khye'u khyod kyi las kyi sgrib pa zad kyis④/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dran par gyis la skye bo'i tshogs chen po la yang shes par gyisasrete/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po ston cig /de nas khye'u de sa las mi bdun srid tsam du 'phags nas lus las 'od phyung ste/ 'od des mnyan yod thams cad dang / 'dzamapo)bu'i gling thams cad snang ba chen po rgyas par gyur to/ /'od des brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / de ma yin pa lha brgya stong mang po gzhan dag la yang yang dag par bskul bar gyurashenas/ skad cig thang ciganyeyud tsam de la bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyishezhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lha'i me tog dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kye ma byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di5)'od kyis snang bar bgyis nas/ sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa dag gi don bgyis so/ /zhes ched du rjodarwa)pa de skad ched du brjod de/ de ltar khye'u de'i ming snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 0zhes bya bar 48—717

btags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang khye'u 'di snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes 1bya bar gyur cig ces/ khye'u de'i ming la rjes su yimatsharang ba mdzad do/ /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bar snang de rilas babs te/ sa la 'dug pa dang / de sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / rang gi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas 'di lta ste dper na/ grogs po lo brgyad lon pa'i lus gzugs yongs su grub par gyur pa de 'dra bar 'dug go/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis khye'u de la lha'i ras bcos bu zung cig nadabyin te/ kye khye'u nga la snying brtse ba'i phyir ras bcos bu'i zung 'di gyon la gcer bur ma 'dug shigaye) /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni gos kyi rgyan bgos pas mdzes pa ma yin gyi/byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni chos kyi rgyan thogs na mdzes so/ /kau shi ka de lta mod kyi 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan gang dag yin pa de dag nyon cig /byang chub kyi sems ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ byang chub kyi snying por 69brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa'i rgyan ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ sems can thams cad mngon du 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /dam bcas pa brten 75pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan 8)te/ shes rab yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa ni byang 9chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ sgyu dang g.yo sel bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyor ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /lhag nyu pa'i bsam pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi 48—718

rgyan te/ thams cad las ༄17khyad par dus 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /nga rgyal med pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos 'dod pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ shes rab yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur rol/ /slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pa 7ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ chags pa med pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /nor thams cad yongs su gtong ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/smon lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa dang des pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro dang sgra skad lta bu'i tshig tu 'gyur ro/ /dam bcas pa brtan 4zhing sems mi zhum pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ bya ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thob pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i 5ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshig rab tu dbye ba shes pa'i shes rab ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ bag la nyal ba cadang lta bar smra ba dang / kun nas ldang ba thams cad rnam par sel bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ 'khor ba na 7yongs su mi skyo bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la zhe rmona'agras pa med pa'i sems ni byang 48—719

chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don la skyo ba med par 'gyur ro/ /zang zing med par chos ston pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ shes rab kyis7)bdag dang gzhan sgrol bar 'gyur rol/ /chos sgrub pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gos kyi rgyan te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spong b.radza 'gyur ro/ /kau shi kum rnam grangs 'dis 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' gang chos kyi rgyan 'di lta bu dag57ldan pa de nam yang gcer bu ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis khye'u de la shin tu dga' ba dang dad pa skyes5snyenas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis ras bcos bu'i zung 'di len du stsal bar59)gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khye'u ras bcos 7)bu'i zung 'di longashel gyon cig /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ras bcos bu'i zung blangs nas bgos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la gshegs so / /de na skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / tshong dpon dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dag ngo mtshar du gyur te/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la blta ba dang /bcom ldan 'das la yang blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / mchod pa'i phyir 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mthar gyis bsod snyoms bzhes 48—720

te/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyabatupa'i ma'i khyim ga la ba der gshegs so/ /gshegs nas kyang cang mi gsung bar phyogs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ma ngo tsha nas/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir sgor ma byung ngo / /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang gi khyim du song nas/ ma la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag gi sngon gyi nongs pa yis/ /khyod kyi mngal du bdag mchis te/ /yum gyis nongs pa snye/ma lags kyis/ /'osngo ltar gnod parasnyim mdzad cig /thugs brtse ldan te bskyed pas na/ /bdag gi sbyin gnas khyod lags so/ /zhal tsha ma mdzad ma 'dzem par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du bzhud/ /de ltar khyod mngal bdag mchis pa/ /khyod kyis brnyes pa legs par brnyes/ /lus kyi dge ba'i las rnams kyang / /rnam par 'dren la zhu ba mdzod/ /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ku 'a)lha'i me tog man 'osnyir ba dag dang / lha'i spos dag dang / lha'i gos dag bdag la stsol cig /de dag bdag gi skyed pa'i ma 'di la stsal na to/ /'dis de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bgyis nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyed tsho /par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/khye'u de la lha'i me tog man dā 1 ra ba dag dang / lha'i spos dag dang / lha'i gos dag byin no/ /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas ma la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yum cig lha yitsha/1me tog man dā 12ra/ /blta 1 sdug mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dang / /spos dang na bza' 'di dag blang mdzod la/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas de la dbul ba mdzod/ /'jig rten dag na pha ma zas skom 48—721

dang ske/ /nor dang gos kyis mchod pa mchod ma lags/ /gzhan du gang dag chos la sbyor bgyid pa/ /des na de dag mchod pa bgyis par 'gyurayon/ /rkang gnyis dam pa de la mchod mdzod la/ /byang chub mchog tu smon lam brtan par mdzod / /bdag ni dus dus khyod kyi drung mchis te/ /yun ring dus nas skul ba bgyid pa lags/ /gnong zhing zhum pa'i sems su ma mdzadashepar/ /rangs pa'i sems dang dga' ba thob mdzod la/ /rang byung rgyal ba bzhugasalgepa der bzhud de/ /skyes bu mchog gi pa)zhabs la phyag mdzod la/ /mgon po de la me tog spos rnams dang / /de bzhin na bza' rnams kyang gtor nas su/ /rgyal ba de las dge ba'i rtsa bskyed de/ /byang chub mchog tu sems kyang bskyed pa mdzodam/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni brtan gyur nas/ /gang dag dad pasalgergyal la gus bgyis pa/ /de dag rnam smin 'jig mgon bka' stsal ces/ /rang gabyung rgyal ba de la zhu ba mdzod/ /ri de nas bud med des 6)bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ zhu ba ji skad bstan pa bzhin du gus pa dang bcas par yongs su zhus so/ /zhu ba zhus pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa 'dis / /ngan 'gro'am mi khom 'gro mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bye mang mnyes byas nas / /mi yi dam pa sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du bsod snyoms bzhes nas/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / skye bo phal po che gzhan dag dang yang thabs cig hu )tu grong khyer nas byung ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba 48—722

ga la btuder gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zas kyi bya ba mdzad de / nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas chos nyanam du gzhug pa'i phyir bzhugs so/ /de nas yul ko sa la'i da rgyal po gsal rgyal dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalam④te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das gang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos rnam pa de lta bu dag dang ldan pa'i khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de ga la mchis/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas mthong ste/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis khye'u de'i lus gzugs yongs su grub pa lha las 'das pa'i mdog dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab kyis brgyan pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ sngon las byas shing bsags pa ji lta bu zhig gis 'di ltar 'di'i lus yongs su dag par gyur snyam mo / /de nas khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang /rang gi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sems kyi yongs su rtogs〈ltapa sems kyis shes nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag rtag tu byams sems dag sems ldan/ /gang dag mi brlang mnyen zhing dran ldan la/ /legs par bsdams shing drang la tshangs spyod pa/ /de dag lus ni rnam par dag par 'gyur / /gang dag sdig pa spong zhing mi spyod la/ /rtag tu dge ba mi chung rnam spel zhing / /gnod par sems dang khro ba rnam spong ba tsho/ /de dag lus ni rnam 48—723

par dag par 'gyur/ /gang dag sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /gus dang bcas par rtag tu mchod byed cing / /gzhan la rdeg 'dodasko7ldigs mo mi byed pa/ /de dag lus ni rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /gang dag gzhan la phrag dog ser sna dang / /de bzhin nga rgyal dag kyang mi byed la/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa byung ba mi rjodamachi pa/ /de dag lus ni rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /gzhan la co dri rib dang smad pa dang / /bshung ba dag ni nam yang mi byed cing / /gzhan la 'khrul pa'i glags lta mi byed pa/ /de dag lus ni rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di chos chen po dang ldan pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das las kyi sgrib pa gang zhig gis/ khye'u 'di bud med khyim thab rtso)ma mchis pa'i mngal du skyes la/ derasnyiyang khang stong dul)bor bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ 'di nas bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das pa⑦/ de'i tshe de'i dus (sredan/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes7bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs de'i gsung rab la byang chub sems dpa' gnyis shig byung ste/ lha bzang zhes bya ba dang / sa zhes bya ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni phyir mi ldog 48wa 724

par gyur cing / don du7nyung ba/ bya ba nyung ba/② dben pa la dga' ba/bsam gtan dang / mngon par shes pas rnam par brtses bar gyur to/ /de la mibyang chub sems dpa' sa zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni chos rgya chen po dang ldan par ma gyur te/ lha bzang gi g.yog byed do/ /de ha cang grong dang /grong rdal ⑤dang / yul 'khor dang / pho brang 'khor dag tu 'jug ste/zhugs nas kyang bya ba mang zhing byed pa mang bar gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang des de la khyod ci'i phyir rnal 'byor dang spong ba 6)la brtson ④par mi byed par ha cang bya ba mang zhing ha cang byed pa mang zhes bsgo zhing bstan tol/ /des de la yang dang yang bskul bas desakhros shingashe'akhrugs te yid ma rangs nas/ gnod sems su gyur pa des lus dang sems ma rung bar7byas te/ngan〈nyedu bsams〈snyenas tshig rtsubasapo smras pa/ nal gyi bu/ sbyar ma'i bu/skyes pa gzhan las grub pa khyod kyi pha ma yang med na/ khyod la shes rab bamanya/tshul khrims lta ga la yod ces des ngan du bsams te / tshig rtsub po smras pa/mi mthol mi 'chags mi 'dor gyi/ zhe la 'dzin te/ de byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang de la rtag tu ngan sems dang ldan zhing byams pa'i sems med par gyur to / /byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang gis kyang de snod ma yin no snyam tunyenas bkyed parwarnyedang / de de bas kyang byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang la ngan du sems shing bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod tsho//de/ snyan pa ma yin pa dang / grags pa ma yin pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjodasngo kye do/ /de las bsags shing tshogs su byas pa des lus zhig ste me/ shi ba'i 'og tu bud med khyim thab nyemed pa'i mngal du skyes so/ /byang chub kyi sems bsrungs pas (3des 48—725

na sems can dmyal bar ni ma skyes so/ /de btsas ma thag tu bud med des lam srang chen por bor te/ der de khyi dang / spyang ki dang / ci7spyang rnams kyis zos so/ /rgyal po chen po tshul 'di 'dra bar 'di bskal pa dgu bcur sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dang / nyam thag pa 'di lta bus 'chi ba'i dus byas shing btsas pa btsas pa 'anon yang bor bar gyur te/ yang skye bo phal po che 'di skad du nal gyi bu sbyar ma'i bu (gu'adi la khyi dang sbyang ki dang / ce 98)spyang rnams za'o zhes 'dzer to/ /rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa' sa zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod som nyi'am/ yid gnyis za bar gyur na rgyal po chen po khyod kyis de de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di de'i tshe de'i rimanodus na byang chub sems dpa' sa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po 'di'i las kyi sgrib pa ni zad⑥/kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sems ni rnam par sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mnyes par byas/ ngan 'gro thams cad ni bcad nas/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi mnyes par byas shing /bsti nistang du byas/ ri mo byas/ mchod pa byas nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi drung du tshangs par spyod pa spyad 1 )do/ /chos yongs su btsal ba la yang brtson par gyur〈rteto/ /rgyal po chen po de sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag nyid chen po 'di thob bo/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar na las nag po dang / dkar po dag chud za bar 'gyur ba med do/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na mkhas pas lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las bsdam hu par bya ste/ srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i las mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 48—726

'das la yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' lha bzang zhes bgyi bar gyur pa des/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob lags sam/ 'on te da dung du 3)yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par ④bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha bzang de ni de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nasatshangs par spyad pa spyod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal 'byung zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po ④gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos gus par bgyis te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bsnyen par bgyi'o//bsten par bgyi'o/ /bsnyen bkur bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen cing bsten te/ bsnyen bkur bgyis na zhudage ba'i chos thob (rmepar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i chos thob pas tso bsam pa dge bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa dge bas sbyor ba dge bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyor ba dge bas dge ba'i las bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /las dge bas 'gro ba dge bar mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba dge bas dge ba'i grogs po mgu bar bgyid do/ /grogs po dge bas sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do/ /bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa ma bgyis shing dge ba'i las bgyis pas bdag la gdung bar〈mi 'gyur/ gzhan la gdung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag dang gzhan rjes su srung bas tsho/ )byang chub kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi lam la gnas pas lam ngan par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi don bgyid 48—727

nus pa dang / skal ba mchis pa dang / mthu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis tshig 'di legs par smras so/ /rgyal po chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi chos nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos du dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ①mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / zab mo'i chos rnams la yang bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khye'u byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / zab mo'i chos rnams la yang bzod pa thob par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhesan/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shes pasal 'jug pa ④dang / chad pa dang / rtag pa rnam par spong ba dang sems can med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gang zag med par 'jug pa dang / stong pa nyid la mos shing / stong pa nyid lasaspyod yul ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang ske/ zab mo'i chos rnams la yang bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /khye'u gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ bzhisnyigang zhe na/ sngon gyi mtha' dben pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' mi 'pho ba dang / da 48—728

ltar byung ba 'jig par shes pa dang / dus gsum mnyam pa nyid de bzhi po de dag go/ /gzhan yang bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ lus dben pa dang /sems dben pa dang / chos dben pa dang / las dben pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /gzhan yang bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas la chos nyid du mthong gi gzugs su ma yin pa dang / chos la 'dod chags dang bral bar mthong gi yi ge dang / 0)nges pa'i tshig tu ma yin pa dang / dge 'dun la 'dus ma byas su mthong gi tshogs su ma yin pa dang / shes rab kyi mig yongs su dag par 'gyur ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /gzhan yang bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bsdu ba'i dngos po mi gtong bas pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / thabs dang5bshes rabasrel mkhas pa dang / sems can med par rnam par dpyod pa dang snying rje chen po ste/ khye'u byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / zab mo'i chos rnams la yang bzod pa thob ④par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhi pa bsgrubasnyepa bstan pa 'di bshad pa na khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi skye ba'i chos la bzod par thob par gyur te④/ de dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis ta la bdun srid tsam du steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags par gyur to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od 'phro ba kha dog sna tshogs/ kha dog du ma byung ba 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /48—729

dkar po dang / le brgan dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu ste/ kha dog du ma de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa snang bar byas te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi tsho)bar du mngon par byung nas/ zla ba dang nyi ma rnams kyi 'od mog mog por dun/byas te/ slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs teni/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la tu gzar5༄nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis don de zhus pa/ bltapo)sdug bltar 'os gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis rab mdzes shing / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'od kyis 'od mdzes57)pa/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /tshul khrims 'phags shing spyod pa legs spyad pa/ /ting 'dzin shes rab bsags pa'i ye shes 'od/ /rnam grol snying po stobs ldan yang dag gzigs/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /bzod pa'i stobs ldanas8)stobs kyi shugs mnga' ba/ /brtson 'grus mngon par 'phags te mi bskyodalo)pa/ /mig tu sdug cing bden pa bzhi gzigs pa/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku mnga' sra brtan mi shigs pa/ /sred med bu mthu sred med bu bas mchog /tshangs dbyangs sgra snyan 'jam pa'i dbyangs ldan pa/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /bzhugs sna 7kyang tshangs dang de bzhin lha tshogs kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug ma mthong la/ /gus dang bcas pas kun nas blta07bgyid pa/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /khyod kyis chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa 48—730

bskor / /mi rtag sgras ni lha dang lha min dang / /de bzhin klu dang gnod sbyin rab bskyod pa/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /snang ba mnyes hu)shing mun pa rnams khubral ba/ /kun nas spyan mnga' mnyam pa nyid bzhugs pa/ /yon tan mchog mnga' yon tan snying po bstan/ /'dzum pa mdzad de bdag la bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa shing tamagul bdun srid kyi steng gi bar snang la 'dug pa byamathong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di bskal pa grangs med pa brgya'i rige'og tu bskal pa kun tu snang byed ces bya ba la/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par spyod pa zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur meb/bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba nyid du 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par spyod pa de ni 'di lta bur yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ dper na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de la nyan thos brgyad khri'i dge 'dun yod par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sum khri nyis stong gi 48—731

gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi mthus stan las langs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed kyi bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' ba'i nyin zhag gcig (nya)go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' ba'i bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje snying pos rab tu 'dul ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gyi bskal pa de 5)ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gdon mi za bar pad mo rab tu rgyas pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams phyir mi ldoga'i pa'i 'khor lo dbyangs kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo dbyangs kyi bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rdul dang bral ba'i nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams rdul dang bral ba'i bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i chosangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mar me ldan gyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi 48—740

khams mar me ldan gyi bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams 'od bzang po'i nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams 'od bzang po'i bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'od zer rab tu rgyas7pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' bar dka' ba'i nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' bar dka' ba'i bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par shes pa thams cad blo gros 'od zer rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par brgyan gyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par brgyan gyi bskal pa de ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i thugs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams me long gi dkyil 'khor dbyangs kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams brtag cing bgrang ba la 'jug pa'i tshul 'dis sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag bcur tshang ba'i rdul phra rab snyed 'das pa'i pha rol na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i sa yongs su sbyong ba'i 2khyad par can 'jig rten gyi khams pad mo dpal gyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ngam/ 'dzin tam/klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang 1rgya cher yang dag 48—741

par rab tu ston na/ de 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho rab 'byam0)dag gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams de'i mdun na bzhugs par 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du skyedza ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gnang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po dga' zhing de skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyas pos smras pa la mngon par bstod dol/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rdzogs so49// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //( ge

khog /'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄7na / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya maṇ+ḍa la aṣ+ṭa nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/② 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad ces ②bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa du mas yongs su bskor te/ mdun gyisasnyibaltas nas chos ston to༅/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rgyal po bkod pa zhes bya ba zhig 'khorasheder 'dus par gyur 0te 'dug pa des 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de mthong nas ltad 48—745

mor gyur te/ de stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis sangs rgyas 'byung ba bye ba khrag khrig phrag du ma zhig 'das na gang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ci 'dra ba de7nyunye'adra bar ma gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi zhu ba bstan pa 'di'i lan stsal du gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis thos na yang ②dbugs phyin par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor yang dag par gzengs stod 52)pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rgyal po bkod pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu nyon cig gedang dris pa lan gdab pa dkyil 'khor brgyad cesatso)bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs gang ngas sngon so so'i skye bo'i dus na kun tu bsten cing bsgoms te lan mang du byas pa de bstan par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /de'i dus na khyim bdag drag shul can gyis byin zhes bya ba zhig shin tu ma dad cing yid du mi 'ong ba'i chos lnga dang ldan zhing / chos 'dul ba la rgyab kyis phyogs so/ /dge slong rnam par rgyal ba 'byung ba zhes bya ba zhig khyim bdag de la snying brtse ba'i phyir yang dang yang du rgyun mi 'chad par khyim bdag de'i khyim du 'gro'o/ /re zhigasrin dus gekyi mthus khyim bdag de dge slong de la rjes su chags pa dang bcas pa'i sems su gyur nas/ re zhig nin khyim 48—746

bdag des legs par bya ba'i las kyi 'bras bu dris so/ /de nas dge slong des skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir dang /'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi skye bo phal po che'i don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir khyim bdag de la dkyil 'khor brgyad ces7bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstanalo te/ khyim bdag dkyil 'khor brgyad cesashebya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs gang zhe na/ bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o / /des 'khor phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur te/ gang dang gang du skyes par chos dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/'khor mang pos ④lus phun sum tshogs nas gzugs bzang po nyid thob par 'gyur / yo byad phun sum tshogs pa 'thobashonyapar 'gyur te/ btsal7mi dgos par yo byad rnams 'byor bar 'gyur/ lus sra zhing brtanashel lus phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par 'gyur zhing / de la ri dang rtsig58)pa rnams kyang sgrib palo)mi byed de/ phun sum tshogs pa bzhi po de dag 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas khyim bdag de dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par 7gyur nas/ dge slong de'i rkang pa la phyag byas te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad ston cig dang / des bdag la mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong rnam par rgyal ba 'byung bas khyim bdag de'i bsam pa shes nas yang dag par rab tu bstan te/ rigs kyi bu nyon cig dang bstan par bya'o/ /des na lci ba gsaratshwa 1bsres pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham par bya/ /sems can kun dang thun mong du/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin dang / /gang dag ma 'ongs da ltar byung ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang / /rang sangs rgyas dag gang 48—747

yod pa/ /de dag rnams la yongs su bsngo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor khor yug tu༅)te/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams bya ste/ /'jig rten dbang dang byams pa dang nas/ /thub pa skyes mchog nam mkha' dang / /kun tu bzang po blo ldan dang ske/ /gsang ba pa yi50bdag po dang / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang ske/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel dang / /de bzhin sa yi0snying po ste/ /de dag gi ched du dkyil 'khor brgyad bya'o/ /khyim bdag 'di ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cesam bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs yin te/ 'di ni bdag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de las mngon sum du thos so/ /khyim bdag gzhan yang nyon ༅cig /kun nas skal ba 'thun pa yinya//'khor rnams gang zhig 'dod pa des/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad ni bri0bar bya/ /gang zhig brgya byin nyid dang ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bdag po dang / /lha mi rgyal po'i rgyal srid dang / /blo ldan sna tshogs gzugs bzang 'dod/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor mchog brgyad bya/ /seng ge'i rgyal po bkod pa 'di ji snyam du sems / de'i tshe dge slong rnam par rgyal ba 'byung ba zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na de ltar mi blta ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong rnam par rgyal ba 'byung ba zhes bya bar gyur to//seng ge'i rgyal po bkod pa de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag drag shul can gyis byin pa zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du som nyi'am yid gnyis za na de ltar mi blta ste/ nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na drag shul can gyis byin pa zhes bya ba'i khyim bdag tu gyur to/ /ngas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas pa'i bar dang / sangs rgyas nyid thob kyi5khyabar du tshe rabs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum de 48—748
